jobDescription: The Therapies team in Healthcare & Biomedical Division is responsible for shaping and delivering initiatives to support the growth of therapeutic biotech companies, with a focus on Precision Medicine, AI in Drug Discovery and Development, biomanufacturing technologies, and clinical trials enablement.
jobResponsibilities:
This role plays a key part in driving the growth and development of the therapeutic biotech ecosystem.

1. Industry & Programme Development

  • Formulate strategies and develop programmes to support therapeutic biotech companies.

  • Drive initiatives in key domains such as Precision Medicine, AI in Drug Discovery and Development, biomanufacturing technologies, and clinical trials enablement.

2. Enterprise Development & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Identify and account manage innovative start-ups and high-growth enterprises.

  • Work closely with government agencies and ecosystem partners to support company growth and expansion.

  • Engage stakeholders including venture builders, incubators, accelerators, and investors.

3. Market Intelligence & Industry Advancement

  • Research and analyse local and global industry trends.

  • Promote adoption of emerging technologies and industry best practices.
jobRequirements:
What You’ll Be Using and Applying

  • Degree in Life Sciences, Bioengineering, or a related discipline.

  • At least 2 years of relevant experience in life sciences, biotech, healthtech, or related domains, with exposure to account management, business development, or similar roles (in biotech, healthtech, or start-up environment is preferred).

  • Strong project management and organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and timelines effectively.

  • Demonstrated analytical thinking, with excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • Strong business acumen and proven ability to build and manage stakeholder relationships.

How We Work Together

We value individuals who work well with others, communicate clearly, take ownership of their work, and are open to learning and improvement. You should be comfortable navigating change and contributing positively to a collaborative team environment.

agencyDescription:
The Skills and Workforce Development Agency (SWDA), a statutory board under the Ministry of Manpower (MOM), drives lifelong learning and workforce development to enable Singaporeans to take charge of their careers, learn for life, access good jobs, and grow in fulfilling careers. We enable employers to build a skilled, future-ready workforce, design quality jobs, and adopt skills recognition practices. Together with our partners, we build a trusted, high-quality, industry-relevant, and innovative ecosystem that meets the evolving workforce needs of both businesses and workers.   

Guided by our vision of a Singapore where everyone can grow in fulfilling careers, we live our promise of Building Skills, Growing Careers by nurturing lifelong learning, strengthening employability and enabling career growth for all, including our own officers, through a continuous learning culture and a supportive, flexible, inclusive working environment that fosters innovation, collaboration, and well-being.

So, join us to be part of a dynamic team driving the national SkillsFuture movement and building a strong Singaporean core. Together, we create opportunities, transform lives, and shape the future of work.
jobDescription:
The Manager/ Senior Manager in the Corporate Planning Division within the Skills and Workforce Development Agency (SWDA) will take on work areas such as:
• Managing SWDA’s corporate planning cycle and developing SWDA’s corporate workplan
• Conceptualizing, tracking and reporting key performance metrics and outcomes
• Facilitating and/or representing SWDA in international engagements to build strategic partnerships and foster knowledge exchange.
• Managing and coordinating key Board activities and requirements

We are looking for a proactive, driven and results-oriented individual with strong writing, presentation and stakeholder management skills. The candidate should also be meticulous and capable of synthesizing complex information into clear recommendations, and adept at managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.

The Senior Manager will be expected to handle work of greater complexity and manage additional projects.
jobResponsibilities:
Corporate Planning

  • Shape and drive SWDA’s corporate strategy in support of national and Ministry priorities.
  • Lead SWDA’s corporate planning cycle, translating long-term goals into coherent organisational plans and outcomes.
  • Facilitate senior management retreats and drive internal communications to build organisational understanding, alignment, and ownership of SWDA’s strategic direction.
  • Continuously strengthen corporate planning frameworks and processes to enhance organisational agility, effectiveness and impact.

Performance Management

  • Drive SWDA’s corporate performance architecture through the design and oversight of enterprise-wide theories of change, and development and tracking of performance indicators.
  • Report on data-driven insights and provide a consolidated view of organisational performance to support senior management decision-making and strategic reviews.
  • Monitor and evaluate progress against corporate priorities and communicate organisational performance and impact.

International Relations

  • Develop and manage SWDA’s international and regional engagement strategy, fostering strategic partnerships and representation at key forums (e.g., ASEAN).
  • Identify and advance opportunities for international cooperation, knowledge exchange and stakeholder engagement to support SWDA’s strategic priorities.
  • Conduct horizon scanning and environmental analysis to identify emerging trends, best practices, and opportunities relevant to SWDA’s work.
  • Manage international engagements and visits, including coordination with government agencies on diplomacy and protocol matters.

Leadership and Governance Platforms

  • Steward and provide secretariat support for key leadership and governance platforms, including Board and Senior Management meetings to support robust decision-making and execution.
  • Ensure effective Board governance, including Board appointments, induction, remuneration and reviews to ensure compliance with public sector governance frameworks.
jobRequirements:
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to synthesise and communicate complex information into clear and actionable recommendations.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage, influence and collaborate effectively with senior stakeholders including senior management, Board members, Ministries and external partners.
  • Proven ability to navigate ambiguity and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment, while maintaining a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Experience in corporate planning, performance management, data analytics and/ or international engagement would be advantageous.

  • Manager: Up to 6 years of relevant work experience in corporate planning. Those with no relevant experience but have been involved in relevant projects or short stints in similar areas / functions can apply.

    Senior Manager: At least 6 years of relevant work experience in corporate planning.

    Successful candidates will be offered a 2-year contract in the first instance and may be considered for an extension or be placed on a permanent tenure.

    Candidates are encouraged to sign up for a Careers & Skills Passport (CSP) account and include your CSP public profile in your resume. Please check out www.myskillsfuture.gov.sg for details on the CSP.

jobDescription:
The Malay Heritage Centre (MHC) provides cultural exposure and learning opportunities for visitors of all ages and interests. Situated amidst the Istana Kampong Gelam, Gedung Kuning and the surrounding Kampong Gelam precinct, the Centre acts as a vital heritage institution for the Malay community in Singapore. Through its exhibits, programmes and activities, the Centre hopes to honour the past whilst providing a means for present-day expression. The Malay Heritage Centre is under the management of the National Heritage Board in partnership with the Malay Heritage Foundation.

In this role, you should have a strong passion and interest in Malay history, culture and heritage. You understand the importance of establishing partnerships and the need for building rapport and engaging the community to increase appreciation and understanding of Malay heritage. You are also excited about developing collaborative programmes to cater to different groups of audience, bringing heritage and culture to life. This is a role where you will be contributing actively to the development of culture and heritage of the historic Kampong Gelam precinct.
jobResponsibilities:
As the Manager of Programmes, you will be responsible for the conceptualisation, planning and implementation of the Centre's diverse programming initiatives across physical and digital platforms.

Key Areas of Responsibility

  • Conceptualise, plan and implement festivals, programmes and initiatives onsite, offsite and online to engage diverse audiences and enhance visitor experience

  • Create compelling and culturally authentic content aligned with MHC's strategic outcomes for both physical and digital consumption

  • Prepare comprehensive programme proposals, budget management, KPI reporting, project evaluation and post-programme analysis to ensure programme effectiveness

  • Identify, foster and maintain strategic partnerships with community stakeholders, businesses, government agencies and cultural institutions to create a vibrant precinct ecosystem and extend programme reach and impact

  • Collaborate effectively with other departments within MHC including education, outreach, curatorial and marketing teams to further awareness and appreciation of MHC's narrative

  • Actively develop relationships and partnerships with stakeholders through co-created programmes, initiatives and other forms of meaningful engagement

  • Monitor programme budgets and maintain effective vendor relationships to ensure cost-effective delivery

  • Evaluate programme success through visitor feedback, attendance metrics and stakeholder engagement to inform future programming strategies

  • Provide support for major programmes and events in the MHC calendar, along with other duties as assigned
jobRequirements:
An ideal candidate should possess the following:

  • [Partnership Management & Development] Ability to identify and assess relevant partners to form strategic alliances with and co-curate initiatives to increase vibrancy in the precinct
  • [Project Management & Evaluation] Ability to oversee programme implementation to ensure that programmes meet objectives, quality standards, timelines, and budgets
  • [Content Creation & Curation] Ability to research, propose and present heritage content in innovative ways, delivering programme objectives that resonate with the target audience and bring collective value for partners
  • [Audience Management] Ability to develop and implement engagement strategies and activities that cater to different visitor segments and align with the Centre's goals, evaluating its effectiveness to continuously improve audience engagement

Work Experiences and Knowledge

  • Background in Event Management, Arts, Humanities, Communications or a related field
  • Preferably minimum 3 years of relevant working experience in heritage-related projects, cultural programming and/or events management
  • Experience in digital content creation and online programme delivery is advantageous
  • Strong passion and interest in both local and Malay history, culture and heritage
  • Resourceful team player with strong interpersonal skills and excellent written and verbal communication abilities
  • Meticulous attention to detail with proven ability to multi-task effectively
  • Demonstrated project management capabilities and problem-solving skills
  • Preferably fluent in English and Malay (but not mandatory)
  • Flexibility to work outside regular office hours, including evenings, weekends and public holidays, as required

jobDescription: Incentives Management Division (IMD) is part of SWDA’s Incentives Management and Enforcement Group (IMEG) which contributes to pan-organisational efforts of building an effective, responsive and inclusive CET eco-system through effective grant management, Skills Development Levy (SDL) collection and enforcement against fraud and abuse. IMD administers training grants, training allowance and SkillsFuture Credits (Enterprise and Individual) to contribute towards the development of a responsive and high-quality CET ecosystem.
jobResponsibilities:
Reporting to the team lead, the successful candidate will be primarily responsible for reviewing and developing business processes for SkillsFuture Enterprise Credit (SFEC), augment operational efficiency and improve service delivery in funding administration for SFEC. Due to similarities with SkillsFuture Credit (SFC), the candidate will also assist with work related to SFC.

Responsibilities and Competencies:

Operational Process Design and Implementation

  • Design, develop, and implement effective operational processes relating to funding administration.

  • Implement business process re-engineering and digitisation initiatives, including incorporating business requirements into system specifications and coordinating with business technology on system implementation.

  • Enhance the experience of companies and individuals utilising SFEC or SFC for approved programmes

  • Review claims and evaluate appeals

Project Management and Technology Integration

  • Lead project management efforts in the area of system enhancement and/or development.

  • Drive operations and technology integration initiatives to enhance operational efficiency.

Policy Development and Compliance

  • Review workflows and develop Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and guidelines in alignment with funding policy implementation plans.

  • Build and continuously strengthen processes and operational policies to achieve high service standards.

Stakeholder Engagement and Support

  • Engage with training providers and other stakeholders to support and address queries, ensuring smooth operation in grant administration.

  • Assist in the management of the outsourced service partner to maintain effective service delivery.

Data Analysis and Reporting

  • Work with large datasets to perform data extraction, collation, tracking, and analyses.

  • Draw insights from data analyses to facilitate funding administration, risk management, and process redesign.

  • Collate data and statistics and prepare information for reporting purposes.

Secretariat Responsibilities

  • Perform secretariat responsibilities for a multiple-agency workgroup, ensuring effective coordination and communication.

What we are looking for

  • Possess the required competencies to execute the job duties proficiently

  • Manager: 3 to 5 years of relevant work experience in grants, operations, project management, or system development

  • Senior Manager: At least 6 years of relevant work experience in grants, operations, project management, or system development.

  • Good analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Proficiency in systems and design thinking methodologies.

  • Ability to work independently, within a team, and across teams.

  • Good interpersonal relationship skills and adaptability to a fast-paced work environment.

  • Good verbal and written communication skills, including stakeholder management and presentation skills.

  • Proficient in word processing, spreadsheet, and presentation applications.

  • Knowledge of SkillsFuture Grants and Continuous Education Training (CET) and industry experience are an advantage.

  • Prefer someone who has experience in public sector and with a policy experience.

jobTitle: Assistant Director, Infection Control & Strategic Coordination (NICHE)
agencyDescription:
The Communicable Diseases Agency (CDA) was established in 2025 as a statutory board under Singapore's Ministry of Health (MOH) to serve as the central authority for public health policymaking to manage and control the threat of communicable diseases. This is aimed at strengthening Singapore's public health capabilities built during the COVID-19 response to ensure a unified command and coordinated approach across all situations, from routine disease control to future outbreaks.

CDA safeguards the nation from communicable diseases through disease surveillance, outbreak investigations, vaccination programs, public education, and global health collaboration. Beyond domestic activities, the CDA aims to expand Singapore’s global outreach and foster collaboration with international partners.
jobDescription:
The Assistant Director supports the Deputy Director by contributing to the strategic oversight and performance management of Infection Prevention and Control (IPC) efforts, ensuring alignment with national IPC strategic objectives. The role supports the national IPC programme and international collaboration efforts, enabling synergies between local implementation and global knowledge exchange.
The position leads operational effectiveness across the national IPC initiatives, facilitating coordination between stakeholders, and providing support for IPC committees and workgroups. In addition, the role supports international collaboration efforts by engaging the global partners and expert networks to facilitate knowledge exchange, benchmark best practices, and contribute to international IPC initiatives. This includes translating global evidence into locally relevant policies and programmes, while strengthening the agency’s contribution to the broader global IPC landscape.
You will be leading a team and working in a fast-paced and dynamic environment that would require the ability to manage multiple priorities and stakeholders, and both operational and strategic responsibilities simultaneously.
jobResponsibilities:
• IPC Programme Development

Lead the development and implementation of comprehensive national IPC initiatives, including community-based programmes that extend beyond traditional healthcare settings. Lead initiatives that strengthen infection control capabilities across primary care facilities, long-term care institutions, community healthcare providers, and other community sectors including schools, workplaces, and residential facilities.

  • Outbreak Preparedness and Response Support

Contribute to preparedness for and response to infectious disease outbreaks, including coordination of measures such as isolation, quarantine, and IPC interventions across sectors. Collaborate with government agencies, healthcare partners, and community stakeholders to enhance pandemic preparedness and coordinate response activities for infectious disease outbreaks and public health emergencies.

  • Preparedness Planning and Policy Development

Leader the development, review, and implementation of national IPC policies, frameworks, and operational plans for pandemic preparedness. This includes planning for IPC measures across healthcare and community settings (e.g., isolation and quarantine, personal protective equipment use, environmental hygiene, and infection control practices) and ensuring alignment with national response strategies. Work with stakeholders to operationalise IPC requirements and ensure readiness for surge scenarios and infectious disease outbreaks.

  • National IPC Coordination and Capacity Building

Support the Deputy Director and other sub-units within ICSC in and coordinating national-level IPC efforts, capacity building programmes, and policy development initiatives. Engage with international stakeholders and partners to enhance local IPC capacity through knowledge transfer and collaboration. Implement quality assurance frameworks to monitor the effectiveness of coordination efforts and lead continuous improvement initiatives based on performance data, stakeholder feedback, and emerging international best practices.

  • International Collaboration and Strategic Partnerships

Support and strengthen international collaboration to position the agency as a key contributor in the global IPC landscape. Build and maintain strategic partnerships with international institutions and expert networks to drive knowledge exchange, benchmarking, and co-development of IPC best practices and guidelines. Provide secretariat support in international technical workstreams and guideline development, while translating global evidence into locally relevant policies and advancing national IPC priorities through global platforms.
jobRequirements:
• Minimum 8-10 years of relevant experience in healthcare, public health, or IPC, with demonstrated experience in policy development, guideline development, or evidence synthesis. Demonstrated experience in performance management and strategic oversight of healthcare programmes. Previous experience working with national health agencies preferred. Track record of managing complex stakeholder relationships and multi-disciplinary teams. Experience in inter-agency coordination and secretariat functions highly desirable.
  • Minimally tertiary qualifications from recognised discipline, preferably in nursing, medical, pharmacy and other healthcare fields.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with experience in developing documents and reports will be considered a significant advantage for this role.
  • Sharp thinker: Analyses problems, makes sound decisions under pressure.
  • Communicator: Connects with diverse stakeholders, delivers complex information clearly.
  • Self-starter: Takes initiative, owns projects, works independently.
  • Adaptable: Responds effectively to changing priorities and threats.
  • Lifelong learner: Committed to continuous professional development.
  • Team leader: Able to lead and motivate teams effectively in high-pressure environments whilst maintaining team cohesion and performance standards.
  • Professional: Demonstrates integrity, manages stress well, data driven. Ability to lead a team and work collaboratively in a dynamic environment.

Key Competencies Required:

  • Thinking Clearly & Making Sound Judgements – Strong analytical and critical thinking abilities to support the crafting of sound policy recommendations; ability to grasp timelines, operating context and ground realities.
  • Learning & Putting Skills into Action - Possesses the drive and curiosity to learn and apply new skills, knowledge and new ways of working.
  • Improving & Innovating – Ability to seek continual improvements, and to innovate and experiment while managing the risks involved.
  • Working Effectively with Stakeholders – Ability to mobilise and rally partners and stakeholders towards a collective purpose.

As part of the shortlisting process for this role, candidates may be required to complete a medical declaration and/or undergo further assessment.

jobTitle: Senior Software Engineer (NGPO Strategy – Ecosystem Development)
agencyDescription: The Civil Aviation Authority of Singapore's raison d'etre is to develop the air hub and aviation industry in Singapore, expanding Singapore's links to the rest of the world. We enable opportunities through aviation, making connections, opening doors and enabling choices in people's lives.
jobDescription:
The Next Generation Programme Office (NGPO) Strategy branch is looking for motivated software engineers with a collaborative, proactive attitude and a passion for continuous learning.

You will join a dedicated team responsible for developing software solutions for the Next Generation Air Navigation System (ANS), with particular emphasis on the development of Aeronautical Information services.

If you are an adaptable, proactive software engineer with a passion for best practices and continuous learning, we would love to hear from you. Join us and contribute to building innovative software solutions for the future!
jobResponsibilities:
Key responsibilities include:

  • Develop & Maintain Mission-Critical Systems: Design, implement, and maintain software solutions for safety-critical applications, ensuring compliance with industry standards for reliability, safety, and performance.

  • Coding: Work with a wide range of programming languages and tools (e.g., C++, Python, Java, Rust, GoLang, etc.) depending on project requirements, adapting quickly to new technologies as needed.

  • Software Safety & Security Focus: Apply software safety and security best practices in your coding, testing, and development processes.

  • Team Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration: Lead and guide software development teams, providing technical mentorship to junior developers and coordinating project deliverables, whilst working closely with various stakeholders, architects, and other software developers to design, implement and deploy mission-critical systems. Foster best practices in software development methodologies across the team.

  • Testing & Validation: Develop comprehensive test plans & test cases to ensure software integrity through unit testing, integration testing, and system-level validation, etc. Participate in code reviews and static code analysis to identify and mitigate potential risks early in the development cycle.

  • Deployment: Perform ICIT (Installation, Check-out, Integration and Testing) and system validation in the production environment.

  • Troubleshooting & Debugging: Proactively identify and resolve performance, safety, and reliability issues in both development and production environments

  • Documentation & Reporting: Maintain thorough documentation for code, processes, and test results, ensuring all compliance and audit requirements are met.
jobRequirements:
• Trained in Software Engineering, Computer Science or Information Technology or equivalent.
  • Minimum 6 years of professional software development experience in enterprise, mission-critical environments
  • Genuine passion and keen interest in software development, with enthusiasm for learning new technologies, staying current with industry trends, and continuously improving technical skills.
  • Strong knowledge in common integration patterns including cloud-native patterns such as microservices and, streaming such as lambda and kappa patterns.
  • Knowledge of Application Programming Interfaces (APIs) for web services using REST and RESTful web services, with familiarity with API Gateways as an optional skill. Knowledge of messaging broker middleware / COTS packages such as Solace publisher / subscriber and Solace event streaming
  • Understanding of cybersecurity concepts in the domain of cloud technologies, architecture and deployments (e.g. how things are connected and potential risk areas)
  • Knowledge and practical experience of virtualized and containerized deployments
  • Good knowledge of Cloud technologies and Cloud-native architectures for system design and delivery. Strong focus on cloud-agnostic solutions using Kubernetes, Helm, and Terraform, with familiarity with implementation experience on operationalised cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure being a plus.

Engineer desired skills and experience

  • Experience with multiple programming languages (e.g., Python, TypeScript, Java, Rust, C++, Go, React).
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms, microservices, and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Knowledge of continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines and version control tools (Git).
  • Experience with automated testing frameworks and test-driven development (TDD).
  • Experience in high-availability, high-performance systems, and real-time software development.

Your appointment designation will commensurate with your relevant work experience. Successful candidates will be offered a 3-year contract in the first instance, and may be considered for placement on a permanent tenure or subsequent contract renewal.

agencyDescription: MHA - Singapore Police Force (SPF)
jobDescription:
This role is part of MHA’s Civilian Generalist career track. Learn more: https://go.gov.sg/civiliangeneralist 

The Singapore Police Force (SPF) plays a critical role in keeping Singapore safe and secure with our mission to prevent, deter and detect crime.

The Centre for Protective Security (CPS) was operationalised to drive the implementation of the Infrastructure Protection Act (IPA) and support the transformation of the security industry. The key functions of CPS are Infrastructure Protection Regulation, Capability Development and Protective Engineering. In addition, CPS collaborates with various public and private stakeholders to reinforce the IPA and synergise efforts to improve the security industry. 

The Outreach & Engagement Branch collaborates with strategic partners on capability development and security/outreach initiatives, promotes best practices in security services procurement, and performs the public communications function for CPS-related queries, feedback, and requests to support MHA in implementing policies and establishing standards to build a competitive security industry.

As a Manager, Outreach & Engagement, you play an important role in developing and implementing sustained engagement with CPS stakeholders to propagate Protective Security (PS) knowledge and performing the public communications function.

You will be placed under the Management Executive Scheme.
jobResponsibilities:
As a Manager in the Outreach & Engagement Branch in CPS, your roles and responsibilities include:
•	Collaborating on capability development initiatives with strategic partners.

•	Developing and implementing CPS’s stakeholder engagement plan.

•	Co-developing and delivering security/outreach initiatives across various industries by working with MHA Headquarters and Home Team Departments on National Programmes such as SGSecure training and counter-terrorism seminars.

•	Engaging private sector stakeholders on security issues and conducting needs analysis to deliver appropriate solutions.

•	Designing and conducting training on protective security initiatives for CPS-run courses.

•	Collaborating with protective security community and industry stakeholders to educate public on security initiatives and raise the profile of the security industry.

•	Growing Communities of Practitioners through outreach and engagement of stakeholders to facilitate exchange of expertise and information with industry partners.

•	Driving efforts in branding, public and internal communications for CPS.

•	Driving the publicity of CPS’s work areas by reviewing and designing communication materials and managing CPS Intranet and Internet web pages.

•	Managing public feedback and queries in accordance with SPF’s service delivery standards.
jobRequirements:
•	Prior work experience in training, community engagement or communications, Protective Security, Infrastructure Protection or Risk Management would be advantageous.

•	Possess strong analytical and strategic thinking skills.

•	Possess effective interpersonal and communication skills to engage people at all levels and ability to work independently are essential.

•	Resilient and work effectively in a dynamic environment.

•	The officer must be a strong team player in collaborating and contributing beyond one's immediate scope to achieve shared outcomes for the team.

•	Possess a can-do attitude and willingness to take on diverse tasks to support the team's objectives.

•	Experience in industry-standard design tools like Adobe Creative Suite preferred.

Short-listed candidates will be contacted within two weeks of the application closing date.

jobDescription:
CAAS Next Generation Programme Office is looking for a strong, driven, and dynamic esteemed engineer candidate to be part of the team.
You will be part of the multi-disciplinary team overseeing the entire life cycle management of next generation Radar Systems, starting from system planning and system design phase to implementation phase and transiting to operations and maintenance phase.
jobResponsibilities:
The ATMSSP is responsible for conceptualization, implementation, and management of multiple IT and Operational Technology (OT) systems.

In this role, the officer is expected to undertake the following areas of work:

Radar Project Delivery

  • Plan and manage Radar projects and ensure alignment of project to the user objectives within established scope, cost and schedule

  • Coordinate and work with other teams for building and network infrastructure integration, ATM integrations and resolve deployment and integration issues

  • Lead and liaise with other technical teams to resolve impediments, incidents and issues

Governance, Risk and Compliance

  • Ensure system compliance to CAAS and Government (Instruction Manual 8 and Cybersecurity Code of Practice) requirements, policies and standards

  • Ensure risk and safety framework is adhered to and carry out risk and safety management for radar projects

  • Identify and mitigating risks which may impact the successful delivery of the radar systems

  • Supporting audit and addressing findings

Vendor contracting and management

  • Managed vendors and contractors to meet the project delivery and operation needs

  • Perform procurement of the systems, including its evaluation of the proposed solutions

Stakeholder management

  • Work closely with multiple stakeholders both internal and external (including other government agencies, system suppliers, maintenance operators, operation users, IT consultants/auditors etc.)

  • Coordinate, liaise, support and conduct meetings to facilitate and validate the implementation in accordance with national and international cybersecurity standards and requirements
jobRequirements:
• Trained in Electrical or Electronics Engineering or equivalent with preferably 3-5 years of relevant working experience in project management and system implementation

  • Experience in project management, vendor management, incident management, problem management

  • Experiences with the operations or maintenance of safety critical systems (for example radars) are preferred

  • Possesses knowledge or understanding of Radar systems’ architectures and environments

  • Strong experience in managing business, IT and senior stakeholders

  • Sound understanding of the technical aspects of systems integration in an environment with diverse technologies

  • Strong communication skills and ability to influence to gain consensus from multiple stakeholders when required

  • Familiarity with Government IM8 and CCoP and ATM domain will be an added advantage

  • Good analytical skills, and able to multi-task and deliver results in a timely manner

  • Excellent technical troubleshooting skills

  • Self-driven, creative and team-oriented person with good interpersonal and organizational skills, positive attitude and able to work under pressure

  • Ability to travel for overseas visits, meetings and training

Your appointment designation will commensurate with your relevant work experience. Successful candidates will be offered a 3-year contract in the first instance, and may be considered for placement on a permanent tenure or subsequent contract renewal.

jobDescription: You will be part of the Enterprise Workforce Transformation Division to oversee and drive the implementation of Workforce Transformation programmes/grants/initiatives to support enterprises in embarking on Workforce Transformation and strengthening its nexus with Enterprise Transformation.
jobResponsibilities:
Responsibilities

- Planning and implementation of key workforce transformation (WT) initiatives under the Enterprise Workforce Transformation Division including but not limited to

Come be a part of this journey if you’re passionate about creating boundary-pushing work that drives behavioral change.

You will be part of HPB’s Physical Activity Department, within the Physical Activity and Healthy Ageing Division, dedicated to making active living a cornerstone of daily life. The department empowers residents to stay active by providing the knowledge, opportunities, and support needed to build sustainable habits. The department designs and delivers impactful programmes, from physical activity initiatives to literacy and community-driven efforts, ensuring residents have the knowledge and opportunities to stay active. By partnering with government agencies, industry leaders, and key stakeholders, it expands access to inclusive, high-quality physical activity options across daily routines and leisure time. Grounded in evidence informed, data-driven insights and capability development, the department evolves its strategies and work to drive participation, enhance well-being, and embed active living as a way of life.
jobResponsibilities:
As a key member of Physical Activity Division, you will play an integral role in the planning and execution of nationwide physical activity strategies and programmes. Collaborating with both internal and external stakeholders, including HPB’s appointed contractors, you will ensure efficient and effective delivery of the programmes.

Your responsibilities will include review of operational processes and managing key aspects of contract and contractors’ management. You will ensure that contractors are delivering services in alignment with HPB’s objectives while adhering to contractual and compliance requirements. Additionally, you will also coordinate the audit process and work closely with internal stakeholders to manage risks and optimise resources.
jobRequirements:
Join us if you are a detail-oriented and self-motivated individual who enjoys working in a highly matrixed, dynamic and fast-paced environment. You should also possess:

  • Good analytical skills and attention to details, including the ability to develop new processes for more efficient delivery.

  • Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to effectively manage and address the different needs and expectations of both internal and external stakeholders.

  • Ability to communicate effectively with verbal, written and presentation skills to present ideas and concepts.

  • Track record in managing and implementing community-based programmes

  • Experience in the monitoring and compliance of contracts, ensuring adherence to terms and conditions while managing risks and performance.

  • Relevant working experience in developing and implementing initiatives for the general population, as well as qualifications in sport and exercise, health-related sciences, or business management will be advantageous.

Successful candidates will be offered a 2-year contract.

agencyDescription:
The Communicable Diseases Agency (CDA) was established in 2025 as a statutory board under Singapore's Ministry of Health (MOH) to serve as the central authority for public health policymaking to manage and control the threat of communicable diseases. This is aimed at strengthening Singapore's public health capabilities built during the COVID-19 response to ensure a unified command and coordinated approach across all situations, from routine disease control to future outbreaks.

CDA safeguards the nation from communicable diseases through disease surveillance, outbreak investigations, vaccination programs, public education, and global health collaboration. Beyond domestic activities, the CDA aims to expand Singapore’s global outreach and foster collaboration with international partners.
jobDescription: The Deputy Director plays a pivotal leadership role in shaping and advancing Singapore's infectious diseases research agenda. The incumbent will lead the implementation of CDA's research strategy, driving high-priority initiatives that generate robust evidence to inform policy decisions and evidence-based practice across major outbreaks, pandemics, and endemic infectious diseases. The role carries senior oversight responsibility for CDA's research operations, encompassing strategic planning, governance, regulatory compliance, and enterprise risk management. The Deputy Director will also spearhead the establishment of CDA's research implementation arm, cultivate high-value partnerships with local and international centres of excellence, and champion research training initiatives to build a sustainable pipeline of skilled research talent. Through close collaboration with CDA research divisions and relevant stakeholder groups, the incumbent will foster synergy and shared ownership in delivering CDA's research objectives.
jobResponsibilities:
• Lead and align CDA research divisions and relevant CDA groups, fostering synergy and shared ownership in the achievement of CDA's research objectives

  • Facilitate actively to the development and implementation of Singapore's national infectious diseases research strategy

  • Provide senior oversight of CDA's research operations, ensuring sound strategic planning, robust governance, regulatory compliance, and effective enterprise risk management

  • Drive high-priority national infectious disease research initiatives, including building and sustaining core outbreak research capabilities that generate robust evidence to guide policy decisions and evidence-based practice during major outbreaks and pandemics

  • Contribute actively to the establishment and long-term sustainability of core national research capabilities on endemic infectious diseases

  • Spearhead the design and implementation of research training initiatives to systematically develop and enhance research capabilities across CDA building a pipeline of skilled research talent

  • Cultivate and steward high-value strategic partnerships with local and international centres of excellence, including academic institutions, healthcare clusters, and public health agencies

  • Drive the monitoring and evaluation of CDA research outcomes and KPIs, delivering regular reports to senior stakeholders

  • Spearhead the establishment and operationalisation of CDA's research implementation arm, laying a strong foundation for sustainable and impactful research delivery
jobRequirements:
• Degree in a relevant field such as public health, life sciences, or a related discipline with minimum 15 years of relevant experience

  • Proven experience in research administration and management, including overseeing research operations, governance, and compliance

  • Demonstrated experience in strategic planning, policy development

  • Minimum 5 years of senior leadership or team management experience, with a track record of leading multidisciplinary teams in a complex organisational environment

  • Strong leadership capabilities with a demonstrated ability to lead, align, and inspire cross-functional teams towards shared research objectives

  • Proven track record in cultivating and managing high-value strategic partnerships with local and international academic institutions, healthcare clusters, and public health agencies

  • Strong strategic thinking and analytical capabilities, with the ability to translate complex research findings into actionable insights and policy recommendations

  • Meticulous with strong attention to detail, and excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to produce high-quality reports for senior stakeholders

  • Resilient and composed under pressure, with the ability to manage multiple high-priority projects and deadlines simultaneously

  • Independent, self-driven, and adaptable, with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment with evolving priorities

As part of the shortlisting process for this role, candidates may be required to complete a medical declaration and/or undergo further assessment.

jobDescription: As a member of HDB’s Strategic Communications & Engagement Group, you will be part of a dynamic team under the Engagement and Partnerships Department responsible for the development and implementation of communications and engagement strategies to promote understanding of HDB’s policies and programmes.

The role involves but is not limited to:

  • Develop a pool of credible third-party advocates who can support HDB’s policies and programmes and amplify HDB’s key messages to their networks
  • Develop communications and engagement savviness and capabilities across HDB staff so that they can fulfil their role in enhancing and promoting the image and brand of HDB

We are looking for a motivated communications professional who is skilled in stakeholder engagement and can tailor communication plans to promote understanding and advance support for HDB policies and programmes to a wide range of stakeholder groups.

You should possess an excellent command of English and strong interpersonal skills. Candidates must enjoy working with people and engaging stakeholders; and possess strong critical thinking skills. You should also have a keen interest in current and international affairs, thrive in a fast-paced environment and have an eye for detail.

Fresh graduates are welcome to apply.

agencyDescription: The mission of the Singapore Land Authority is to optimise land resources for the economic and social development of Singapore. It ensures the best use of State land and buildings, provides an effective and reliable land management system and enables the full use of land information for better land management.
jobDescription:
Senior Executive, Land Management & Operation

Tenancy, Licence and Land Management Division
jobResponsibilities:
You will be part of a dynamic team managing State land under SLA's purview. Your responsibilities will include:

  • Addressing and attending to public feedback on land management and maintenance matters.

  • Consulting and coordinating with various Government agencies on proposals to use SLA-managed land.

  • Processing the issuance of Temporary Occupation Licences (TOLs) for the use of vacant SLA-managed land.

  • Liaising and coordinating with Licensees to ensure compliance with the Temporary Occupation Licence (TOL) terms and conditions for the use of land

  • Planning and conducting of site inspections to ensure proper land maintenance and prevent the unauthorised use of SLA-managed land.

  • Working in close partnership with other Government agencies, contractors, and other service providers to ensure that municipal issues are promptly attended to and resolved.

  • Administering land and maintenance policies and the processing of financial transaction matters related to TOL administration.

  • Verifying land ownership and updating land data records & other land-related information.

  • Contributing ideas to improve work processes through creative & innovative thinking.
jobRequirements:
• Collaborative team player with strong attention to detail, resourcefulness, and a passion for service delivery

  • Strong analytical, communication, and interpersonal skills, with proficiency in data processing

  • Tech-savvy with the ability to leverage AI tools to improve work processes and systems

  • Open to continuous learning and able to contribute creative, out-of-the-box thinking when developing work solutions

  • A relevant background in Facilities, Estates, or Environmental Management would be advantageous, but not required

  • Candidates with 1-2 years of relevant work experience in TOL administration are welcome to apply

jobTitle: Senior Assistant Director/ Assistant Director (One Health Office)
agencyDescription:
The Communicable Diseases Agency (CDA) was established in 2025 as a statutory board under Singapore's Ministry of Health (MOH) to serve as the central authority for public health policymaking to manage and control the threat of communicable diseases. This is aimed at strengthening Singapore's public health capabilities built during the COVID-19 response to ensure a unified command and coordinated approach across all situations, from routine disease control to future outbreaks.

CDA safeguards the nation from communicable diseases through disease surveillance, outbreak investigations, vaccination programs, public education, and global health collaboration. Beyond domestic activities, the CDA aims to expand Singapore’s global outreach and foster collaboration with international partners.
jobDescription:
The CDA is a new government agency that is being established by the Ministry of Health (MOH) to oversee Singapore’s communicable disease preparedness, prevention and control, surveillance, risk assessment and outbreak response. The One Health Office’s role is to drive and improve One Health coordination and collaboration at the national level with key stakeholders.

As Senior/ Assistant Director for One Health Office of the Communicable Diseases Agency (CDA), you will work with the Director and Deputy Director/ One Health Office to establish and build Singapore’s One Health capabilities. If you are passionate about One Health, collaboration across sectors to achieve common objectives, and starting initiatives from ground-up, this may be the position for you.

You will be working in a dynamic environment that would require the ability to manage multiple priorities and stakeholders at the same time.
jobResponsibilities:
• Implement, and review the overall framework for One Health plans of actions for communicable diseases to safeguard public health and reduce incidence and impact of endemic and emerging diseases in Singapore.
  • Implement national One Health research and surveillance programmes of endemic and emerging communicable diseases of One Health priority, which will inform prevention and control policies and strategies.
  • Implement capability development efforts in One Health workforce core competencies.
  • Provide desktop research and technical advice on specified One Health related issues and matters,.
  • Collaborate with One Health partners to spearhead the implementation and monitoring of progress.
  • Stay abreast of trends, best practices, and directions relating to One Health
jobRequirements:
• Tertiary education in areas related to medicine, veterinary medicine, environmental health, public health, epidemiology. Relevant postgraduate qualifications (MSc, PhD) or certifications in public health or One Health related disciplines are advantageous.
  • At least 5 years of relevant experience in managing public health or One Health related programmes and initiatives.
  • Possess managerial and organizational skills to manage collaborative activities with a team of public health and One Health professionals effectively.
  • Possess basic public or One Health expertise and knowledge to interact effectively with local and international experts and assess scientific evidence.
  • Possess strong analytical capabilities and capacity to think about issues comprehensively and systematically, to overcome barriers and achieve One Health actionable strategies.
  • Possess strong interpersonal, communication, and stakeholder management skills to drive effective collaborations with stakeholders within and outside of the agency.

As part of the shortlisting process for this role, candidates may be required to complete a medical declaration and/or undergo further assessment.

agencyDescription: The mission of the Singapore Land Authority is to optimise land resources for the economic and social development of Singapore. jobDescription:
Assistant Manager, Estate Management

jobTitle: [LTA-TRO] MANAGER, OPERATIONS COMMAND CENTER, STRATEGIC OPERATIONS & CONTRACTS

  • Lead the development and analysis of operations policies and procedures to enhance efficiency, effectiveness and data-driven decision-making.

  • Conduct in-depth analysis of operational data to identify trends, optimise performance and guide operational strategy.

  • Provide strategic guidance and support to teams across the division, ensuring alignment with operational goals and objectives.

  • Conduct cross-function collaborations to align operational strategies and analysis with broader business goals.

  • Prepare reports and presentations that illustrate trend and cost-benefit analysis, challenges and trade-offs to key stakeholders.

  • Work on inter-agency coordination and address operational issues to ensure smooth collaboration and alignment across all relevant parties.

jobRequirements:

  • Strong leadership, analytical and strategic thinking skills.

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence and work effectively across teams.

  • Ability to manage complex projects, analyse data effectively and drive results in a fast-paced environment.

  • Experience working within a Command Center or similar operational environment is a plus.

  • Experience in contracts management, procurement processes, or vendor relationship management is preferred.

agencyDescription:

• An opportunity to Innovate and Push Boundaries. We value ideas, curiosity and a passion for innovation to transform our libraries and archives.
An organisation that Cares for your Growth and Wellbeing through investment in staff development and wellbeing in a supportive and collaborative environment.

jobResponsibilities:

  • Assist in designing and implementing new evaluation and feedback methods for the Spark!Lab programme.
  • Support the integration of innovative learning approaches, such as storytelling, into Spark!Lab activities.
  • Participate in projects aimed at increasing visitor engagement and retention.
  • Collaborate with the team to research, plan, and execute various improvement initiatives for Spark!Lab.
  • Assist the Project Manager in stakeholder engagement, documentation, and presentation preparation.
jobRequirements:
• Open to students from all disciplines; students with a background in STEM education are particularly encouraged to apply.

  • Creative problem-solving skills and a passion for innovation and hands-on learning.

jobResponsibilities:
Your role is to ensure smooth facilities operations, safety management and service excellence delivery to the members of Public. 

Performing multiple roles is required, covering duties such as Pool Guardian, Fitness Champion, Programme Lead, and Front Desk Services depending on operations deployment needs. Training will be provided. 

In this role, you will,
•	Attend to guest enquiry, handle public feedback, process refund and assist daily bookings of respective facilities.
•	Perform daily reconciliation of accounts and ensure compliance to financial standard operating procedures.
•	Enforce swimming pool rules and regulation to ensure water safety. 
•	Scan the water and surrounding areas to recognise signs of danger, unsafe behaviour and water conditions to prevent incidents.
•	Support swimming pool pump room operations and work with Facilities Management team to ensure pump room equipment are functional.
•	Assist in land rescue, through administering first aid/ CPR/ AED and care for the victim if required.
•	Assist in the daily gym operations and provide guidance to part-time staff to ensure service excellence delivery.
•	Conduct and simple fitness and exercise programmes.
•	Support the planning of programmes and promote programmes and events happening across ActiveSG.
•	Liaise with external instructor, ensuring adequate time is catered for members to sign up for programme. 
•	Prepare and set up venue prior to major events/competitions and ensure all facilities and equipment are ready for use.
•	Performing any other ad-hoc matters.
jobRequirements:
We are looking for self-motivated individuals who value integrity, teamwork and take pride in going the extra mile to provide excellent service to stakeholders and the community. This individual should be a sport advocate through living an active lifestyle and staying active. 

Applicant with no working experience may apply. 

Job Requirements:
•	Qualification in Fitness Studies/Sports Management is advantageous. 
•	A valid Cardiopulmonary Resuscitation (CPR) and Automated External Defibrillator (AED) credential is advantageous.
•	Customer-centric with excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
•	Strong standards towards customer safety in line with our SOP.
•	Able to perform shift work including weekends and public holidays.
•	Well-organised and able to multi-task.

The level of offer will commensurate with applicants’ experience and track records. Successful candidates will be offered a 2/3- years’ contract in the first instance.

Only shortlisted applicants will be notified.

agencyDescription:
The Skills and Workforce Development Agency (SWDA), a statutory board under the Ministry of Manpower (MOM), drives lifelong learning and workforce development to enable Singaporeans to take charge of their careers, learn for life, access good jobs, and grow in fulfilling careers. We enable employers to build a skilled, future-ready workforce, design quality jobs, and adopt skills recognition practices. Together with our partners, we build a trusted, high-quality, industry-relevant, and innovative ecosystem that meets the evolving workforce needs of both businesses and workers.   

Guided by our vision of a Singapore where everyone can grow in fulfilling careers, we live our promise of Building Skills, Growing Careers by nurturing lifelong learning, strengthening employability and enabling career growth for all, including our own officers, through a continuous learning culture and a supportive, flexible, inclusive working environment that fosters innovation, collaboration, and well-being.

So, join us to be part of a dynamic team driving the national SkillsFuture movement and building a strong Singaporean core. Together, we create opportunities, transform lives, and shape the future of work.
jobDescription: You will be part of the EPD Programmes Team, supporting the end-to-end delivery of the traineeship programmes such as the GRaduate Industry Traineeships (GRIT) and the Mid-Career Pathway programme and other programmes as required. Programme Operations and Budget Management

  • Maintain and update monthly programme tracking including status updates and relevant system tagging.

  • Review budget projections from the programme partner, identify discrepancies and flagging anomalies to ensure good cash flow planning

  • Manage monthly budget drawdown requests and track programme savings

  • Support budget reviews and preparation of materials required for funding approval and programme implementation

Data Analysis and Performance Management

  • Review and validate data submissions from programme partners, and spot inconsistencies to support reporting requirements

  • Translate data into charts, and provide written or verbal updates for management meetings and regular reporting to key stakeholders for decision-making

  • Respond to data and progress requests from internal and external stakeholders

  • Support the monitoring of corporate KPIs related to placements and employment outcomes

Stakeholder and Partner Engagement

  • Support engagement with relevant government agencies, ensuring adherence to prevailing policy guidance and preparing the necessary materials and discussion points

  • Support day-to-day coordination with programme partners and contribute to smooth programme delivery and ongoing reviews

jobRequirements:
Relevant experience in programme management, operations, or a related field would be advantageous. Fresh graduates and early-career professionals are welcome to apply.

Knowledge/Skills:

  • Understanding of programme management processes and reporting

  • Experience or familiarity with budget tracking, data management, and performance monitoring

  • Comfortable working with spreadsheets and producing regular performance reports tied to KPIs.

  • Ability to prepare clear and accurate materials for management reporting and stakeholder communication

Abilities/Aptitudes:

  • Detail-oriented with good analytical and organisational skills

  • Good communication skills with the ability to engage effectively across a range of stakeholders

  • Proactive team player with good interpersonal skills

  • Thrives in a dynamic environment, managing competing priorities and engaging effectively with multiple stakeholders

jobTitle: (Senior) Business Partner, Data Governance, Data, Economics & Analytics
agencyDescription:
Enterprise Singapore is the government agency championing enterprise development. The agency works with committed companies to build capabilities, innovate and internationalise.

It also supports the growth of Singapore as a hub for global trading and startups, and builds trust in Singapore’s products and services through quality and standards. 

Visit www.enterprisesg.gov.sg for more information.
jobDescription:
The Data, Economics & Analytics (DEA) Division plays a central role in Enterprise Singapore’s data transformation journey by strengthening the organisation’s data foundations to support informed decision making, policy development, and enterprise growth.

This role partners stakeholders across the organisation to establish robust data governance, management, and security practices, enabling trusted, well managed data to be effectively used across systems, processes, and analytics.
jobResponsibilities:
This role plays a key part in strengthening Enterprise Singapore’s data governance and management capabilities to ensure data is reliable, secure, and fit for purpose.

Data Governance & Quality

  • Design and implement data governance policies, standards, and processes to ensure data is accurate, consistent, and trusted.

  • Establish and maintain data management practices, including clear data definitions, documentation, and lifecycle processes.

  • Drive continuous data quality improvements through effective checks, controls, and issue resolution.

Data Security, Protection & Compliance

  • Strengthen data security and compliance practices, including access controls, data classification, incident management, and adherence to data protection requirements.

Data Strategy & Enablement

  • Contribute to the development of data strategies and plans, including data architecture, usage, and analytics.

  • Work with stakeholders to identify data needs and sources, and ensure systems and processes support consistent data capture, integration, and reporting.

  • Keep abreast of industry trends and emerging technologies, and recommend practical, innovative solutions to enhance data management and usage (e.g. data catalogues, metadata tools).

Business Partnership & Capability Building

  • Partner business units to establish clear data ownership, align on data definitions, and embed good data practices in day-to-day operations.

  • Work with stakeholders to strengthen data literacy and build data capabilities across the organisation.

  • Promote greater data awareness by providing guidance and consultation (e.g. on data classification, proper handling of data, and addressing data-related queries).
jobRequirements:
What You’ll Be Using and Applying

  • A degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Data Science, Business, or a related discipline.

  • Minimum 2 years of relevant experience in data governance and management (including data quality, data ownership, data definitions, access controls, and data protection requirements), data security, or related roles.

  • Ability to apply data tools and technologies such as Excel, SQL, Tableau, or Power BI in a work setting.

  • Exposure to data management, metadata, or data catalogue tools would be an advantage.

  • Experience working in the Singapore public sector or large, complex organisations would be an advantage.

How We Work Together

We value individuals who work well with others, communicate clearly, take ownership of their work, and are open to learning and improvement. You should be comfortable navigating change and contributing positively to a collaborative team environment.

jobTitle: Lead Executive (Risk Management), Planning & Risk Management Dept
agencyDescription: Nanyang Polytechnic is committed to providing quality education and training to prepare our graduates for life and work, equipping them to contribute to the technological, economic and social development of Singapore.   • Provide general administrative and secretariat support for ERM‑related platforms.
  • Support the organising and execution of events and/or meetings under the department’s ambit, as well as take on relevant administrative functions such as finance and procurement for the department.
jobRequirements:
• Good communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to handle, interpret and derive insights from data, using relevant productivity tools (e.g. Excel/Power BI) as needed.

jobTitle: [LTA-TRO] SOFTWARE ENGINEER – TRAFFIC LIGHT MGMT & SENSORS
agencyDescription:
The Land Transport Authority (LTA) is a statutory board under Ministry of Transport that spearheads land transport developments in Singapore. We are seeking dynamic, energetic, highly motivated, passionate and qualified professionals to join us.

Many opportunities & challenges await those who are keen on an exciting career to realise our commitment to envision & implement an integrated transport system.
jobDescription: The Land Transport Authority (LTA) is looking for passionate engineers to build the future of Singapore’s urban mobility. You will join a team dedicated to modernizing our critical national infrastructure, ensuring our traffic control systems are smarter, safer, and more resilient.
jobResponsibilities:
You will be at the forefront of developing the Next Generation Traffic Light Control System. This is a mission-critical project focused on optimizing traffic flow and enhancing road safety across the island.

  • ​Production-Grade Development: Design and build modular, high-performance software components meant for real-world production systems. You will use C++ for real-time, resource-constrained control logic and Python for system automation, data processing, and integration layers. You may also be participating in web applications development if assessed to have the relevant experience.
  • ​Rigorous Software QA: You will be responsible for the end-to-end quality of your code. This includes writing comprehensive unit tests, performing integration testing in simulated traffic environments, and ensuring that software meets the high-reliability standards required for 24/7 operations. ​
  • Edge-to-Cloud Readiness: While current deployments are local/on-premise for security and latency, you will architect modules with a "cloud-ready" mindset (e.g., containerization-friendly, decoupled services), ensuring seamless integration for future cloud transitions. ​
  • Critical Infrastructure Security: Implement robust security protocols to protect national infrastructure. You’ll ensure that the programming approach adhere to "Security by Design" principles. ​
  • Continuous Learning: You will constantly explore new technologies, system architectures, and security practices. You’ll collaborate with diverse teams across the government to integrate cross-agency innovations.
jobRequirements:
We value strong engineering fundamentals and a "production-first" mindset. We are looking for individuals (1–3 years of experience, or fresh graduates who demonstrate exceptional aptitude) who possess:

​​Strong Programming Foundation in one or more of the following:

  • Proficiency in C++ for performance-critical applications, with a focus on memory safety and concurrency.

  • ​Proficiency in Python for building robust internal tools and system modules.

  • Proficiency in in Java for web-based applications development

​Commitment to Quality (QA): Experience with, or a strong understanding of, automated testing frameworks, CI/CD pipelines, and debugging tools. You believe that code isn't "done" until it is thoroughly tested and documented. ​

Engineering Excellence: A proven ability to build high-quality, secure, and maintainable software. You should be comfortable working within Linux-based environments and maintaining high standards in version control. ​Analytical Thinking: The ability to think clearly about abstract problems. You should have strong debugging skills—whether it's tracing a race condition in C++ or validating a logic flow in Python. ​

Collaborative Mindset: Effective communication is key. You will work closely with fellow engineers, policy officers, UX designers, cybersecurity specialists, and various partner agencies. ​

Proactive Initiative: You drive improvements in reliability and security autonomously. You take pride in ensuring that the software governing our roads is failsafe.

​Public Service Spirit: You care deeply about the public good and understand the responsibility of working on critical national infrastructure that impacts millions of lives daily

As part of the shortlisting process for the role, you may be required to complete a medical declaration and / or undergo further assessment.

jobDescription:
This role is with the Hydroinformatics & Hydraulics Division within the Water Reclamation (Network) Department.

Management of the used water network in Singapore is key in ensuring that every drop of used water can be collected and fit for recycling into a sustainable source of water supply as one of the National Taps to meet Singapore’s water demand. The Water Reclamation (Network) Department is responsible for ensuring that all land developments in Singapore are able to convey their used water discharge effectively by the sewerage network to the Water Reclamation Plants for treatment and further use.
jobResponsibilities:
As a Specialist / Senior Specialist in the Hydroinformatics & Hydraulics Division, you will play a key role in developing and managing the Department's hydraulic modelling capabilities. You will maintain and enhance an in-house hydraulic modelling system that enables our sewerage infrastructure planners to perform hydraulic simulations for planning assessments and to design new sewerage schemes to meet future development needs. The modelling system is also for operations engineers’ use to perform hydraulic analyses for incident investigations and network performance studies.

Beyond supporting the routine modelling needs of the users in the Department, you will also serve as the Department's hydraulic modelling specialist, undertaking complex simulation studies, interpreting modelling results, and providing technical advice to planners and engineers for challenging planning and operational scenarios.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and calibrate hydraulic models of Singapore's sewerage network to accurately represent network conditions across different planning base years.
  • Maintain and update hydraulic models to reflect changes in the sewerage network, development projections and operational data, ensuring that the models remain current and fit for planning and engineering assessments.
  • Provide technical guidance, training and modelling support to planners and engineers on hydraulic studies, model setup and interpretation of simulation results.
  • Manage, maintain and continuously enhance the Department's in-house Sewer Hydraulic Analysis and Design (SHAD) system, which has customised modelling tools and workflows to enable non-specialist users to perform standard hydraulic simulations.
  • Call and award maintenance tender to engage a contractor to upkeep and enhance the SHAD system
  • Work closely with planners, operations engineers and IT partners to improve modelling capabilities, automate workflows and strengthen the Department's hydraulics modelling system.
  • Perform advanced hydraulic modelling and scenario analyses to evaluate sewer network performance under various planning, operational and emergency conditions.
  • Analyse modelling results and translate technical findings into practical recommendations to support infrastructure planning, operational decision-making and policy development.
  • ​Identify and deploy applied technologies pertaining to hydro-informatics and hydraulics works to meet department operational needs.
  • Carry out R&D study pertaining to hydro-informatics and hydraulics works that are relevant for department operational needs
  • Engage and network with industry and academic experts to build depth and expertise in the domain.
  • Participate in external forums/conferences to profile PUB as deep subject matter experts in the area of hydro-informatics and hydraulics for sewerage network.
jobRequirements:
Job Requirements :

  • A degree or above in Civil or Environmental Engineering
  • Keen interest in the technical know-how of hydro-informatics and hydraulics
  • Possess strong analytical thinking, managerial and planning skills
  • Independent, willing to learn, result-oriented and self-driven
  • Good interpersonal and strong communication skills
  • Good knowledge in IT
  • Experience/knowledge in sewer modelling is preferred​

Home Team Science and Technology Agency (HTX) is a science and technology agency dedicated to keeping Singapore safe and secure. We partner with the Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA) and Home Team Departments by delivering cutting-edge science and technology solutions across engineering, digital and innovation domains to enhance operational capabilities.

The Ops Systems Engineering team within the Ops Systems Sustainment Centre drives the engineering and long-term sustainment of MHA operational systems.

In this role, you will influence how MHA Ops Systems are supported and maintained by assessing and enhancing O&S (Operations & Support) management across software, hardware, systems and services. Your contributions will help drive continuous improvements in system availability, reliability and operational readiness.

About the Role
Ops Systems Engineering undertakes four categories of work: O&S requirements gatekeeping, flagship programme integration, innovation for O&S, and engineering expertise. You will be assigned a portfolio drawn from these categories based on your strengths and development needs, for example, an officer with deep AI/ML capability may be deployed primarily on AI-enabled innovation, with gatekeeping work for breadth of exposure and selected engineering deep-dives in his/her specialist area. You are not expected to cover all four categories at entry.
jobResponsibilities:
O&S Assurance & Requirements Gatekeeping
•	Review ICT Approval of Requirement (AOR) submissions and project proposals to ensure O&S requirements — maintainability, supportability, obsolescence management, system refresh and mid-life upgrade provisions, and adequate O&S resourcing — are properly specified before approval, minimising downstream handover and sustainment issues.
•	Strengthen and institutionalise O&S engineering standards and review criteria applied at the gatekeeping stage.

Flagship Programme Integration
•	Serve as the O&S engineering representative within integrated Project Management Teams (PMTs) of flagship programmes, shaping system architecture, maintenance design, and support strategy from the design phase onward.
•	Review and evaluate maintenance concepts, reliability/supportability trade-offs, and transition-to-operations plans proposed by project teams and vendors.

Innovation for Operations & Support
•	Identify, prototype, and drive adoption of technologies — including AI/ML, data analytics, and predictive maintenance — to improve the effectiveness and efficiency of O&S works across the ops systems portfolio.
•	Analyse operational and maintenance data to shift sustainment from reactive to condition-based or predictive modes.

Engineering Expertise 
•	Build hands-on engineering competency by working with, or through temporary attachment to, forward-deployed teams supporting live ops systems over a period of time.
•	Progressively take on engineering support for system faults, performance degradation, and sustainment issues, working alongside experienced engineers in the deployed environment.
•	Contribute to engineering assessments supporting decisions such as system refresh and re-platforming, with increasing independence as competency deepens.

•	Basic competency in system management — fault and resolution management, system performance management, maintenance planning and analysis, and obsolescence/life-cycle management.
•	Able to assess system reliability, supportability, and sustainment trade-offs from an engineering standpoint.
•	Strong analytical, problem-solving and communication skills; outcome-oriented, able to manage competing priorities and to hold a technical position constructively when reviewing project team submissions.
•	Self-motivated, proactive and adaptable, with the ability to work independently and collaboratively in cross-functional teams.

•	Requirements review, project management, or experience within multi-disciplinary programme teams.
•	Hands-on technical experience in a domain relevant to ops systems (e.g., command-and-control systems, operational software systems, middleware, integration platforms).

jobDescription: You will support the operational backbone of JTC's Investment Division, ensuring the accurate and timely execution of investment activities across internally managed portfolios and externally placed funds. Performance Reporting and Portfolio Valuation

  • Prepare and review periodic performance reports across internally managed and externally managed portfolios.
  • Perform portfolio valuation reconciliation against custodian and fund administrator records, investigating and resolving discrepancies in a timely manner.
  • Support the production of management reporting for senior stakeholders.

Securities Settlement and Trade Support

  • Support the end-to-end settlement process for the internally managed portfolio, including the confirmation, matching, and settlement of trades.
  • Develop and maintain operational procedures for the internal trading book, and liaise with custodians and counterparties to resolve settlement queries and exceptions.

  • Coordinate cash movements with custodians and fund managers to ensure sufficient liquidity for operational and investment needs.

Counterparty Relationship Management
