Many opportunities & challenges await those who are keen on an exciting career to realise our commitment to envision & implement an integrated transport system.
jobDescription: [LTA-TRO] Senior/ Executive/ Data Engineer - Transport AI Programme, LTA Singapore
jobResponsibilities:
Singapore's land transport network moves millions of people every day. As AI reshapes what's possible in transport operations, the Land Transport Authority is investing in AI capabilities that will meaningfully improve how the network is sensed, managed, and optimised — for commuters, operators, and public officers alike.

AI systems are only as good as the data that powers them. As a Data Engineer in LTA's Transport AI Programme, you will design, build, and maintain the data infrastructure and pipelines that enable AI models and applications to access high-quality, timely, and trustworthy data. You will work across LTA's rich transport data ecosystem — spanning real-time sensor feeds, transit operations data, traffic systems, and road infrastructure — to ensure that data is reliably ingested, transformed, governed, and made available for AI development and production use.

This role reports to the Transport AI Programme Deputy Director and works closely with AI software developers, the AI architect, infrastructure engineers, and industry partners on joint data integration efforts.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines that ingest, transform, and serve structured and unstructured data from diverse transport data sources, including real-time streams and batch feeds.

  • Develop and manage data models, data catalogues, and feature stores that support AI model training, evaluation, and inference across transport use cases.

  • Ensure data quality, consistency, and lineage across the data platform, implementing validation checks, monitoring, and alerting to detect and resolve data issues early.

  • Implement data governance practices in line with Singapore Government data classification requirements, including access controls, data masking, anonymisation, and audit logging for sensitive transport and personal data.

  • Work with the AI Architect and Infrastructure Engineer to design data infrastructure that is performant, cost-efficient, and aligned with LTA's cloud and hybrid environment.

  • Collaborate with data scientists and AI developers to understand data requirements for model development, and translate these into reliable, production-grade data products.

  • Support the integration of external data sources from industry partners, ensuring that data exchange meets LTA's standards for security, quality, and interoperability.

  • Contribute to the development of shared data platforms and reusable data assets that can be leveraged across multiple AI use cases within the programme.

  • Monitor and maintain data pipelines in production, supporting incident response and continuous improvement of data reliability and freshness.
jobRequirements:
• Knowledge in Computer Science, Data Science, Business Analytics or a related field, with at least 3-6 years of relevant professional experience. Candidates will be assessed based on their experience and may be considered at the intermediate or senior level.

  • Proficiency in Python and SQL is expected, along with hands-on experience with modern data pipeline frameworks such as Apache Spark, Apache Kafka, dbt, Airflow, or equivalent.

  • Experience with cloud data platforms (such as AWS Glue, Azure Data Factory, Google Dataflow, or Databricks) and data warehousing or lakehouse architectures is important.

  • Familiarity with real-time or streaming data processing is a strong advantage, particularly given LTA's operational context involving live sensor and transit data.

  • Experience building feature stores or data pipelines specifically for ML/AI workloads is highly desirable. Knowledge of data governance frameworks, data quality tooling, and metadata management practices will set candidates apart.

  • Experience working in regulated, government, or critical infrastructure environments — particularly where data sensitivity and access controls are paramount — is a plus.

  • Comfortable working in cross-functional teams and collaborating with both technical and non-technical stakeholders to translate operational data needs into robust engineering solutions.

  • Strong communication skills to explain technical concepts to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders. Inclination to work in a collaborative, fast-moving Agile environment. Strong in communication with the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly to diverse audience

As part of the shortlisting process for the role, you may be required to complete a medical declaration and / or undergo further assessment.

jobResponsibilities:

You will be part of LTA's Transport AI Programme team, building and maintaining AI-powered applications and services that improve how Singapore's land transport network is managed and experienced. Working closely with data scientists, AI architects, and operations teams, you will translate AI models and capabilities into reliable, production-grade software that public officers and commuters can depend on.

This role reports to the Transport AI Programme Deputy Director and works in close collaboration with industry partners on joint development efforts.

  • Design, develop, and maintain AI-powered applications across transport use cases including public transport operations, traffic management, and road operations.

  • Integrate large language models, computer vision models, and other AI/ML components into operational workflows, including retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines and agentic systems.

  • Model Optimization & Quantization: Apply and benchmark advanced techniques (e.g., quantization, pruning, distillation, speculative decoding) to optimize LLMs and other deep learning models for inference.

  • Evaluate inference engines (vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, Triton Inference Server) and publish recommendations balancing performance, cost, and resilience. Provide hands-on support to agency teams applying these to their workloads.

  • Build and maintain APIs, microservices, and data pipelines that connect AI capabilities to operational systems.

  • Implement guardrails, evaluation frameworks, and observability tooling to ensure AI systems behave safely and reliably in production.

  • Collaborate with industry partners on co-development efforts, maintaining code quality, documentation standards, and integration discipline across organisational boundaries.

  • Participate in red-teaming exercises, prompt-injection testing, and other AI safety activities.

  • Support deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement of AI products in production environments.

• Knowledge in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or a related field and will have 3–6 years of software development experience, with at least 2 years working on AI or ML-integrated systems. Candidates will be assessed based on their experience and may be considered at the intermediate or senior level.

  • Candidate should be proficient in Python and familiar with modern AI/ML frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, PyTorch, or equivalent.

  • Work on areas such as LLM integration, agentic workflows, evaluation harnesses, observability, guardrails, model access, retrieval/memory patterns, and multimodal AI use cases.

  • Use AI coding and development tools to accelerate delivery while retaining human accountability for design and quality.

  • Experience with cloud-native development (AWS, Azure, or GCP), containerisation (Docker/Kubernetes), and CI/CD pipelines is expected. Familiarity with responsible AI practices — such as evaluation harnesses, hallucination mitigation, and model monitoring — is a strong advantage.

  • Experience working in regulated or government environments is a plus.

  • Comfortable working in cross-functional teams and collaborating with both technical and non-technical stakeholders to translate operational data needs into robust engineering solutions.

  • Strong communication skills to explain technical concepts to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders. Inclination to work in a collaborative, fast-moving Agile environment. Strong in communication with the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly to diverse audience.

jobResponsibilities:
• Design robotics systems integrating robot manipulators, computer vision, and end-effectors to solve pick-and-place and object manipulation tasks.
  • Develop manipulation behaviours including grasping, pick-and-place, object reorientation, bimanual handling, and visual or tactile servo for heavy and irregular payloads.
  • Program collaborative robot arms under ROS2, and plan, optimise, and validate trajectories with respect to joint limits, collision avoidance, and cycle-time efficiency.

  • Integrate mechanical, electronic, and software subsystems into a cohesive embodied AI platform, making informed trade-offs between performance, cost, and reliability.
  • Implement diagnostics, logging, and testing tools to monitor system performance and enable rapid debugging in lab and field conditions.
  • Document designs, experiments, and results, and contribute to technical reports, publications, and open-source releases.
  • Supervise student training in robotic projects

​

  • Qualifications in Robotics, Mechatronics, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a closely related field (required).

agencyDescription:
Info-communications Media Development Authority (www.imda.gov.sg) offers a rewarding career that gives you a front seat in the fast-changing infocomm media sector, where technology and content are shaping the way people view the world more than ever.

We offer a wide range of opportunities, where talented individuals and teams can make a difference. Whether you are developing a telecommunications policy affecting consumers or spearheading a scheme to nurture budding media talents, each member of IMDA contributes towards driving innovation, enhancing productivity for economic growth, and improving the quality of life for all Singaporeans.

As a statutory board in the Ministry of Communications and Information, IMDA promotes and regulates the infocomm and media sectors.
jobDescription:
About IMDA
Shaping Singapore's digital future, the Infocomm Media Development Authority (IMDA) leads the development and deployment of emerging technologies across sectors. We Dream, Design and Deliver in the technology and media space driving Singapore towards a limitless digital future.
If you are ready to help architect Singapore's digital future, we want to hear from you.

What the Role Is
The Asia Tech x Programme Office (ATxPO) sits within IMDA's International Group and manages Asia Tech x Singapore (ATxSG), Singapore's flagship technology event platform that convenes change-makers and thought leaders from government and industry to explore how technology can create meaningful impact.

As Assistant Director for Programming and Content, you will lead the team responsible for conceptualising, developing and executing the ATxSummit and ATxInspire series. You will also collaborate with IMDA's industry partner Informa Tech to advance the broader ATxSG agenda, including B2B opportunities through the ATxEnterprise brand.

In this role, you play a central part in shaping the core experience of ATxSummit. Your team drives the development of strategic themes, crafts thought-provoking agendas, and designs engaging sessions that inspire insight and action. You will curate and guide speakers to ensure every session is relevant and impactful. Beyond the main plenary, you will coordinate fringe activities and partner-led programmes to deliver a cohesive and memorable experience across the ATxSG ecosystem. Working closely with internal divisions, senior leadership and global partners, you will help advance Singapore's digital leadership on the world stage.

What You Will Be Exposed To
This role offers a unique vantage point on the issues and actors shaping the global digital economy. You will engage with thought leaders from government and industry, locally and internationally, as well as leading technology companies, research institutions and academia working on next-frontier technologies. Internally, you will work across multiple IMDA divisions and with inter-agency partners, building a broad understanding of Singapore's digital economy priorities.
jobResponsibilities:
You will lead and manage a team to develop and execute the programme, content, partnerships and sponsorships for ATxSG across two key areas:

Programme and Content

You will lead the programming and execution of the agenda for the ATxSummit (Plenary and Village) and ATxInspire series, developing content strategies for panels and sessions in close collaboration with internal and external stakeholders. This includes identifying, engaging and cultivating government and industry speakers, and applying a data-driven approach to programme development and execution.

Sponsorships and Partnerships

You will drive the development and execution of knowledge and event partnerships, serving as the key point of contact for strategic partners including government agencies and key industry organisations. This includes sourcing, developing and executing sponsorship arrangements with industry partners to grow ATxSG as a platform.
jobRequirements:
We are looking for a purpose-driven leader with a strong sense of ownership and accountability, and a genuine interest in technology and its role in shaping society. An understanding of the tech zeitgeist of the day is critical for success in this role.

You should be a self-motivated individual who thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and is energised by complexity and ambiguity. You are a natural networker who builds relationships for the long term, and a strong team player who can work effectively across functions including marketing and events management.

You are mature and professional in your approach, proactive in reaching out to potential partners across industry, associations and government agencies. You communicate with clarity and purpose whether in writing, presentations or stakeholder conversations, and bring with you strong storytelling instincts and meticulous attention to detail.

The ideal candidate would possess 15 to 20 years of experience in conference programming, content development and/or partnership management.

•	Resource planning and procurement:

You will be part of the team overseeing the implementation of Next Generation iATM systems, including (but not limited to) flight plan filing and air traffic flow management. You will play a key role across multiple phases of the project lifecycle, such as approvals, procurement, implementation, testing, maintenance, and system enhancements.

Depending on the project phase, you will work with relevant stakeholders to define system architectures, gather requirements, formulate technical specifications, manage procurement processes, and oversee system implementation, commissioning, maintenance, and enhancements in accordance with Singapore Government and applicable international standards (e.g. SG IM8, ICAO). You will also support the implementation of cyber and data security measures and contribute to the safe and efficient management of air traffic in Singapore.
jobResponsibilities:
Key responsibilities include:

  • Engage internal and external stakeholders to gather requirements, clarify constraints (e.g. security, networking, availability, cloud technology limitations), and translate needs into actionable technical work packages.
  • Support the definition of cloud platform and environment architecture, including landing zones, network segmentation, identity, compute, and storage, and contribute to technical specifications and implementation plans.
  • Lead or participate in technical engagements with Cloud Service Providers (CSPs), GovTech, and appointed contractors to shape the target cloud environment approach on GCC, including account or subscription structure, IAM, networking, and baseline security controls.
  • Review vendor sizing and service selections, including virtual machines, containers, and managed services, to assess whether they meet performance, reliability, scalability, and cost objectives.
  • Support the definition of Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) and configuration management standards, such as Terraform/Ansible patterns, module reuse, and review controls, and assess vendor deliverables against these standards.
  • Support the definition of deployment and release management expectations, including CI/CD controls, quality gates, and rollback strategies, and review vendor pipeline designs and implementation evidence.
  • Contribute to DevSecOps and security-by-design requirements, such as scanning, secrets management, and policy-as-code where applicable, and verify contractor compliance through reviews, testing evidence, and audit artefacts.
  • Support the definition of observability and operational readiness requirements, including logging, monitoring, alerting, SLO/SLA, and runbooks, and review vendor proposals, test results, and readiness or handover evidence.
  • Support the development of integration approaches between systems, applications, and databases using APIs, middleware, and event-driven patterns where applicable.
  • Support issue resolution through root-cause analysis (RCA) and track corrective and preventive actions to closure.
  • Support the definition and governance of integration testing and acceptance criteria, including test plans, environment readiness, and defect triage, and validate that contractor evidence meets the required outcomes.
  • Support project governance activities with project managers, including inputs for procurement, technical evaluations, design/specification approvals, and stakeholder coordination.
  • Contribute to project delivery by tracking technical deliverables, dependencies, risks, and timelines, and support delivery in line with approved plans and budgets.
  • Identify technical and integration risks, assess their impact, and recommend mitigation plans to minimise delays and operational impact.
  • Review, comment on, and maintain key technical documents and vendor submissions, such as system design documents, interface control documents, test plans, and acceptance artefacts, to support procurement, delivery, operations, and audit requirements.
  • Assist in coordinating security reviews and support the closure of findings, including hardening, vulnerability remediation, and security monitoring requirements, in accordance with organisational and regulatory requirements.
  • Engage stakeholders to support proper system integration, testing, and operational readiness for air traffic operations.
  • Provide regular status updates, highlight issues early, and propose resolution options to management.
jobRequirements:
• Trained in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering (Computing), or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience in delivering large-scale ICT systems across the project lifecycle, including working with vendors or contractors on design reviews, implementation oversight, testing, acceptance, and operational handover, is preferred.
  • Good understanding of cloud architecture, Linux or system administration, networking (VPC/VNet, routing, DNS, TLS), identity and access management, and cybersecurity; experience with containers and Kubernetes would be advantageous.
  • Preferred technical skills include the following areas, and candidates are not expected to be experts in all areas: cloud fundamentals (compute, storage, networking, IAM, encryption/key management, and backup/disaster recovery); operational readiness (monitoring/alerting, incident and problem management, SLO/SLA, runbooks, and capacity and cost management); automation literacy (Terraform/Ansible concepts and Git-based workflows); container orchestration (Docker and Kubernetes); and CI/CD and DevSecOps concepts (pipeline controls, artifact/version management, security scanning, and secrets handling).
  • Relevant certifications would be advantageous, such as Cloud Solution Architect, SysOps, DevOps Engineer, Kubernetes, security certifications such as CISSP, or project management certifications such as PMP or Agile/Scrum.
  • Self-motivated with a strong sense of ownership, and able to work independently and collaboratively across teams and stakeholders.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, stakeholder management, analytical, presentation, and negotiation skills, with attention to detail.
  • Willingness to travel overseas occasionally.

Your appointment designation will commensurate with your relevant work experience. Successful candidates will be offered a 3-year contract in the first instance and may be considered for placement on a permanent tenure or subsequent contract renewal.

jobDescription:
Our work in the Resilience and Engagement Division (RED) centres on strengthening national identity, enhancing social cohesion and solidarity, and commitment to contribute to the common good. 

We do this through three pillars of work which have an impact on both locals and newcomers into Singapore society: fostering a strong and inclusive sense of national identity, helping newcomers integrate into Singapore and appreciate what it means to be part of Singapore, and promoting a culture of volunteerism and giving.

jobTitle: Assistant Director, Policy & Strategy Development (2-year contract)
agencyDescription:
Established in 2001, the Health Promotion Board’s (HPB) vision is to build a nation of healthy people.

We aim to empower residents in Singapore to attain optimal health, increase the quality and years of healthy life, and prevent illnesses, disability and premature death.

To achieve this, HPB drives national health promotion and disease prevention programmes, spearheads health education initiatives and creates a supportive environment in Singapore where healthy lifestyle options are available and accessible for healthy living every day.
jobDescription:
The Policy and Strategy Development Division is part of the Policy, Research and Surveillance Group in the Health Promotion Board. The Division’s mission is formulating public health policies and strategies, as HPB progresses beyond promotional approaches to employ regulatory and policy levers to modify health behaviours. We oversee the sodium reduction strategy, including the Nutri-Grade extension to address sodium and saturated fat intake, upstream industry development work in support of policy, as well as substance abuse (tobacco) other emerging areas of public health concerns related to food.

This position offers the right candidate the opportunity to drive evidence-based national policies and strategies in preventive health, to achieve a supportive and sustainable environment for healthy lifestyle behaviours. This is an exciting opportunity to solve some of the most critical issues facing preventive health in Singapore today. The successful candidate will have the opportunity to engage senior stakeholders from across the government and businesses, and influence decision making on public health policies. The successful candidate will also work closely with industry and academic experts, as part of the consultation and strategy development process.

  • Where project requires, take initiative to consult actively with government agencies, companies and experts, to address key stake holders and their concerns, with the objective of achieving successful and sustainable policy and strategy implementation.

  • Collaborate with regulatory agencies and the industry to operationalize solutions and enforce measures.

  • At least 7 years of experience in developmental and planning roles, with project management skills. Some public policy experience will be helpful.

  • Strong strategic thinking and problem-solving skills to identify, define and propose policy solutions for national preventive health problems.

  • Excellent interpersonal and relationship building skills to maintain strong stakeholder partnerships.

jobDescription: As members of our Security Operations Centre (SOC) Team, you will be at the forefront of cybersecurity defence, playing a critical role in safeguarding HDB's ICT infrastructure. Whether delivering timely and actionable threat intelligence to help the organisation anticipate, detect and respond effectively to evolving cyber threats, or engineering and maintaining a robust security operations capability by equipping the SOC with the right tools, platforms and technologies, you will be an integral part of a team dedicated to keeping HDB's digital environment secure.
jobResponsibilities:
Cyber Threat Intelligence Analysis

  • Continuously review and enhance the cyber intelligence framework to provide a systematic and organized framework for collecting, processing, and leveraging intelligence to enhance HDB's cybersecurity posture and decision-making capabilities.

  • Integrate the cyber intelligence framework with the HDB's Security Operations Centre (SOC) and incident response team and ensure that the intelligence gathered is effectively used to detect, prevent, and respond to cyber threats.

  • Continuously monitor and collect information from multiple sources, including threat intelligence feeds, security vendors, dark web forums, social media, and other online platforms, to identify emerging cyber threats and attack trends.

  • Analyse the collected threat intelligence data to identify patterns, trends, and potential cybersecurity risks.

  • Prioritize and triage threats based on their relevance and potential impact to HDB.

  • Conduct in-depth analysis of threat actors, their motivations, capabilities, and tactics, and provide insights on potential risks and impacts to the organization's systems, networks, and data.

  • Produce regular and ad-hoc reports, briefings, and alerts on emerging threats, trends, and risk assessments to relevant stakeholders, including senior management, incident response teams, and other cybersecurity teams. The report shall also provide technical information in a clear and actionable format for various stakeholders.

  • Provide timely and accurate intelligence support on a rostered 24/7 standby duty, and when activated during security incidents, assist incident response teams in understanding the nature and scope of the threat, and provide guidance on containment, remediation and recovery strategies.

  • Support vulnerability management efforts by analysing threat intelligence data to identify vulnerabilities, exploit trends, and potential targets, and prioritize patching and mitigation activities.

SOC Engineering

  • Research and evaluate new and emerging security tools, platforms and technologies, and assess their technical feasibility and suitability for integration into the organisation's existing security infrastructure and workflows.

  • Liaise with product vendors to conduct Proof-of-Concept (POC) and technical evaluation of security tools, platforms and technologies.

  • Responsible for the procurement and implementation of security tools, platforms and technologies.

  • Perform knowledge transfer, prepare documentation, and hand over the operations of newly implemented security tools, platforms and technologies to the Security Operations team.

Process Innovation and Automation

  • Design and refine SOC processes and procedures to enhance operational efficiency and reduce response times.

  • Implement automation and artificial intelligence solutions to optimise SOC operations, improve threat detection and response capabilities.

Professional Development and Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Participate in diverse SOC activities including security monitoring, threat hunting and incident response to broaden your expertise and accelerate career development within HDB's growing cybersecurity function.
jobRequirements:
• Have demonstrable experience and in-depth knowledge in cyber threat intelligence analysis and SOC engineering.

  • Possess strong experience with various cybersecurity technologies including IDS/IPS, firewalls, SIEM platforms, email security, web security, cloud security, and endpoint security solutions.

  • Have at least 2 years of experience as an engineer and/or cyber intelligence analyst in a SOC environment or equivalent cybersecurity engineering/operations role.

  • Demonstrate strong analytical and problem-solving skills with meticulous attention to detail.

  • Can work effectively under pressure, meet critical deadlines, and make sound decisions during security incidents.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with ability to explain technical concepts to diverse stakeholders across the organisation.

  • Have experience in cyber intelligence analysis, implementation of security monitoring and detection solutions, and project management.

  • Hold professional certifications such as EC-Council Certified Threat Intelligence Analyst (CTIA), SIEM, SOAR and XDR/EDR product certifications, or other relevant cybersecurity qualifications.

Good to Have:

  • Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to quality in all security operations.

  • Proven ability to work autonomously while maintaining high standards of reliability, trustworthiness, and integrity.

  • Natural sense of ownership and accountability, taking initiative to drive continuous improvement in security processes.

  • Collaborative mindset with ability to work effectively across cross-functional teams.

  • Knowledge of cloud security frameworks and experience with modern security orchestration tools.

Successful candidates will be offered a 1+1 year contract in the first instance.

jobTitle: Assistant Director/Manager (Analytics), Planning Group Municipal Services Office
agencyDescription:
The Ministry of National Development (MND), the lead government agency responsible for land use planning and infrastructure development, aims to transform Singapore into an endearing home and a distinctive global city. At MND, we aspire to create a quality, vibrant and sustainable living environment for our people. We also strive to shape Singapore into a world-class city of knowledge, culture and excellence – one which keeps pace with global challenges and the rising aspirations of Singaporeans.

Our Vision:

An Endearing Home, A Distinctive Global City
MND's vision reflects our growing emphasis not just on physical infrastructure, but also on the softer aspects of creating emotional attachment in our people, the global talents and corporations whom we attract here. At the same time, it articulates MND's goal of building upon Singapore’s unique distinguishing characteristics to develop Singapore as a global city of knowledge, culture and excellence.


Our Mission:

Develop World-Class Infrastructure
MND will provide quality physical infrastructure for the nation by working with our partners in the public and private sectors.

Create a Vibrant, Resilient and Sustainable Living Environment
MND will strive to make Singapore a livelier and more exciting city, and ensure our nation is well-prepared to face the growing uncertainties and complexities. MND will also maintain the quality and resilience of our built and natural environment to ensure high standards of living, and carry out development that meets the needs of the present without compromising that of future generations.

Provide Affordable and Accessible Public Housing
MND will commit to support Singaporeans' homeownership aspirations and ensure public housing remains affordable and accessible.

Build Rooted and Cohesive Communities
MND will strive to foster our citizens' attachment and love for our homeland and maintain social cohesiveness in our communities, even as Singapore continues to be an open and globalised society.
jobResponsibilities:

• Acquire new data sets to increase data product offering and maximise exploitation potential; and
• Drive user adoption and platform enhancement of Municipal Services Dashboard Plus (MSDB+) platform for government agencies and town council users through continuous engagement with government agencies and town councils, ensuring MSDB+ meets evolving municipal intelligence needs.

• Able to distil critical issues, sense-make from a wide range of information, understand current realities and make sound, timely decision on plan of action.

jobDescription:
As an Associate (Board of Review & Legal Unit), Legal Directorate, you will provide secretarial, administrative and paralegal support to the Tax Boards of Review and the MOF Legal Directorate. 

The Tax Boards of Review are administrative tribunals which comprise the Income Tax Board of Review, the Goods and Services Tax Board of Review and the Valuation Review Board, constituted under the Income Tax Act, the Goods and Services Tax Act and the Property Tax Act respectively. The Tax Boards of Review adjudicate disputes between taxpayers and the respective Comptrollers/Chief Assessor in appeals filed before the Boards.

The Legal Directorate’s mission is to advance MOF’s strategic objectives through sound legal advice and effective policy representations. We strive to be trusted partners in shaping key policy developments and legal policy in Finance.
jobResponsibilities:
The key responsibilities and duties of this position include:

Board of Review
•  Providing administrative and secretarial support to the Tax Boards (including the Chairperson, Deputy-Chairperson and members) to ensure the smooth running of the Boards and effective conduct of tax appeals. This includes:
   o  Assisting and supporting the Boards in all aspects of case management processes and collection of requisite fees for the Tax Boards.
   o  Handling of queries from parties and the public on Tax Boards matters and processes.
   o  Providing staffing assistance on all matters related to appointment of Tax Boards’ members, Board-related events, and the disbursement of honorariums.  
   o  Management of all case records and correspondences related to the Tax Boards.
   o  Engaging in projects to improve processes of the Tax Boards.
 
•  Providing paralegal and administrative support to the Legal Directorate, which will include:
   o  Assisting in maintaining and updating the files, documents and records of the Legal Directorate 
   o  Supporting Legal Counsel through legal research and drafting of legal documents.

•  To provide other forms of secretarial, administrative or paralegal support to the Tax Boards and the Legal Directorate, and any other ad-hoc project work, as required
jobRequirements:
•  Strong administrative and organisational skills
•  Good communication skills and good command of written and spoken English, speaks at least one other language (i.e. Mandarin, Malay or Tamil)
•  Excellent customer service and interpersonal skills to interact effectively with the public, colleagues, Board members, and other stakeholders and partners
•  Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications (including Word, Excel and PowerPoint)
•  Keen learner and ability to work under pressure
•  Adaptable to changes
•  Motivated and able to work independently and as part of a team
•  Meticulous and attention to detail
•  Paralegal skills / background in legal-related studies will be advantageous

jobDescription:
The Government Procurement Function Office (GPFO) oversees the Government procurement policies, practices, systems and workforce. Among other responsibilities, it is responsible for driving transformation of the whole-of-government (WOG) procurement function, including digital transformation.

MOF-GPFO is embarking on a project to refresh the current GeBIZ. GeBIZ is a WOG platform for agencies to publish their tenders and suppliers to submit their proposals.
jobResponsibilities:
The Lead Associate/Senior Associate/Associate (Digital Transformation) will be part of the business ops team to conceptualise, plan and execute the implementation of the new GeBIZ system. The scope will include:

• Working with agencies across WOG to jointly review, challenge and streamline existing procurement processes to enable the digitalisation of a seamless Budget-Procure-to-Pay experience.

• Change management with agencies across WOG to ensure a smooth and effective implementation of the GeBIZ system.

• Work with technical partners and stakeholders in the Budget-Procure-to-Pay value chain to align the goals thereby fostering closer collaboration.

• Manage the tender and the supplier such that the GeBIZ project is executed efficiently and on schedule in an agile manner.

• Explore, leverage and implement innovative new technologies to support end-to-end government procurement requirements.

• Undertake data analytics efforts to ensure proper governance of procurement practices.
jobRequirements:
• Professionals with experience in one or more of the following areas - procurement, implementing organisational systems, digital transformation, project management.
• Ability to look at issues from a WOG perspective, review the status quo and integrate procurement policy considerations and operational requirements with what is technologically feasible.
• Have a dare-to-do attitude and not afraid to challenge the status quo.
• Self-driven and committed individual able to work independently and within teams.
• Strong critical thinking, analytical and project management skills.
• Strong communication skills and ability to work collaboratively with internal and external stakeholders.
• Excellent writing ability and presentation skills.

2. Understand and interpret users’ requirements, conduct trials, obtain budget approval, write technical specifications, and be responsible for the implementation lifecycle development of new communication services.

7. Have knowledge and experience in resilient solution design, with automated service/system recovery and scaling, together with the Day 2 team.

8. Identify and study all preliminary and critical design parameters that may affect the operational and technical performance of the system.

9. Participate in acceptance tests, such as UAT, FAT, OSAT and SSAT, and ensure that deliverables meet tender specifications.

10. Be responsible for initial System Configuration Management.

11. Ensure that delivered hardware and software have not reached end of support, with proper system versioning and accurate capture of delivered assets.

12. Ensure that vendors resolve system faults, including hardware or software bugs, within the contractual turnaround time. For new software fixes, perform regression testing to ensure complete bug resolution without degradation of existing functions.

14. Ensure that project delivery remains within schedule and budget, and that project issues are resolved promptly or escalated to management for attention.

15. Provide regular project updates to HTX management on project milestones, issues and expenditure.

16. Ensure that projects are implemented according to the approved project plan, meet users’ operational needs, and are delivered within the agreed project timeline and approved budget.

17. Identify potential project risks early, assess their implications for the organisation and project, and recommend risk mitigation measures to minimise project delays.

18. Effectively engage and manage all relevant stakeholders to deliver communications services and capabilities.

19. Ensure the proper integration and testing of all hardware and software components so that the system is delivered according to contractual requirements.

20. Work with external agencies and/or Home Team Departments (HTDs).

21. Perform any other duties as assigned

2. At least 3 years of relevant working experience for Engineer/Lead Engineer in a suitably sized enterprise environment. Fresh graduates with relevant internship experience will be considered.

3. Working experience or training in 4G/5G telecommunications is preferred, with extensive knowledge of wireless 3GPP or ETSI and Android smartphone systems design or implementation.

agencyDescription:
Established in 2001, the Health Promotion Board’s (HPB) vision is to build a nation of healthy people.

We aim to empower residents in Singapore to attain optimal health, increase the quality and years of healthy life, and prevent illnesses, disability and premature death.

To achieve this, HPB drives national health promotion and disease prevention programmes, spearheads health education initiatives and creates a supportive environment in Singapore where healthy lifestyle options are available and accessible for healthy living every day.
jobDescription:
The Health Promotion Board’s vision is to make Singapore a nation of healthier people.
Come be a part of this journey if you’re passionate about creating boundary-pushing work that drives behavioral change.


You will be a part of HPB’s Healthy Ageing Programmes which strives to help seniors lead healthier and longer lives by improving and maintaining their functional ability through healthy lifestyle practices and social connectedness. With transformation to the healthcare and the aged care system brought about by national directives such as Healthier SG and Age Well SG, HPB will need to foster closer collaborations with other parts of the healthcare system including General Practitioners (GPs), Active Ageing Centres (AACs) and Regional Health Systems (RHSes) to encourage seniors to participate in active ageing initiatives, adopt and sustain healthy habits on their own and stay healthy and active.
jobResponsibilities:
As a key member of the Healthy Ageing Programmes team, you will support the development and implementation of HPB’s senior volunteer capability and implementation plans to support Active Ageing Programmes (AAPs) in the community as part of the national efforts to encourage and sustain senior social participation through curated volunteering opportunities. This will include working with partners to identify, develop and operationalise meaningful volunteer opportunities that enable seniors to lead, conduct and support community-based AAPs across Active Ageing Centres (AACs) nationwide, and progressively building capability of AACs to independently design, implement and sustain physical activity initiatives of their own.

You will support the development of structured, practical training curriculum, resources and implementation guides for senior volunteers to be equipped with the skills and confidence to support volunteer-led hobby groups involving low-barrier physical activities like brisk walking activities, weekly senior fitness exercises, following virtual exercise workouts, and other accessible physical activity programmes for their peers. The training approach will be informed by the competencies required for various volunteer opportunities and designed to accommodate the diverse backgrounds and capabilities of senior volunteers, ensuring they are implementable by seniors with varying levels of experience.

You will collaborate closely with internal teams and external partners like AACs, training institutions like local Institutes of Higher Learning and Regional Health Clusters — to co-develop volunteer opportunities and access capability requirements to support the implementation of volunteer-led programmes in the community, aligned with national senior volunteering initiatives and roll out plans. You will also work with partners to identify future capability needs and implementation models that would enable AACs to independently recruit, train and deploy volunteer-led physical activity programmes.

You will contribute to capability development efforts by translating policy intent into practical and meaningful volunteer opportunities in the community, whilst strengthening the capability of AACs and community partners to independently design and sustain physical activity initiatives of their own. Through this, you will support HPB’s mission to extend healthy life years through national directives under Age Well SG and Healthier SG, enabling residents to age-in-place and enjoy better quality of life.
jobRequirements:
An ideal candidate will be a technically strong and self-motivated individual with at least 3-5 years of working experience in programme management, learning and development, or community engagement, preferably within the social or health sector. Prior experience working with senior populations, volunteer management, or in a community health setting is strongly preferred. The candidate should also possess:

  • A degree in Social Work, Public Health, Human Resources, Education, Psychology, or a related discipline; postgraduate qualifications are an advantage.
  • Strong understanding of adult learning principles and their application to volunteer training programmes, particularly for senior populations with diverse backgrounds and capabilities.
  • Strong collaborative and stakeholder engagement skills, with confidence in working across multidisciplinary teams and with external partners.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple workstreams in a fast-paced, dynamic environment while maintaining focus on long-term strategic outcomes.
  • Strong written and oral communication skills, with the ability to distil complex concepts clearly and concisely for different target audiences including seniors, community partners and government stakeholders.

Successful candidates will be offered a 1-year contract

As professional outdoor educators, the OBS Instructor’s key role is to help participants gain meaningful learning through outdoor adventure experiences. Starting as a Trainee Instructor, you will undergo a 6-month Basic Instructor Training (BIT) to equip you with the skills to become an operational instructor. 

After BIT, you will be assigned to conduct safe and quality OBS programmes, such as the MOE-OBS Challenge Course; a nationwide initiative for all Secondary 3 students to learn about resilience, build empathy and positive attitude towards challenging situations.

As part of the selection process, all shortlisted candidates will be invited for a 3D2N Instructor Selection Process (ISP), an immersive programme where candidates will experience physically and mentally challenging activities to demonstrate their abilities. The next ISP is scheduled on 18 - 20 September 2026. By applying, you will need to fully commit over the ISP weekend. 

As your safety is our top priority, you may not be able to participate in the ISP if you have any of the following medical/ physical conditions:

•	Cardiac conditions e.g. ischemic heart disease, arrhythmia, congenital heart conditions
•	Respiratory conditions e.g. exercise-induced asthma
•	Seizure (with history of episode/medication within last 2 years)
•	History of anaphylaxis (due to environmental/food allergens)
•	Any conditions that may cause:
a.	Inability to perform strenuous/physically demanding activities and movements for prolonged periods of time (e.g. carry 15 – 20 kgs for 5 – 6 hours);
b.	Inability to see colours or see in the dark/night;
c.	Inability to conduct outdoor activities and independently supervise the safety of minors; and/or
d.	Danger/hazard to self or others in an outdoor/wilderness setting.

CSA also engages with various stakeholders to heighten cyber security awareness, build a vibrant cybersecurity ecosystem supported by a robust workforce, pursue international partnerships and drive regional cybersecurity capacity building programmes. agencyDescription:
Join Us at MSF for a Meaningful, People-Centric Career!

At MSF, our mission is to nurture and build resilient individuals, strong families, and a caring society. We offer meaningful and impactful people-centric careers in the design and delivery of policies, services and programmes. We are an all-inclusive and family friendly workplace where career growth is prioritised through a comprehensive suite of development opportunities to help our officers succeed today as well as be future-ready. We do this through various formal and informal learning and development programmes for officers to build different competencies and gain diverse work experiences within MSF, the Public as well as the Social Service Sectors.
jobDescription: The Family & Early Childhood (FEC) division sits under the Family and Child Development (FCD) Policy Directorate. The FEC division formulates and reviews policies that promote and strengthen families, in support of MSF’s macro outcomes to support marriage and parenthood actualisation and build strong and resilient marriages and families.
jobResponsibilities:
Families are the bedrock of Singapore society. As Assistant Director (Family Policy), you will shape the policies and strategies that help Singaporeans build strong, resilient families — from supporting marriage and parenthood to ensuring that every child gets a good start in life, and that families are supported to care for elderly members with dignity.
You will lead a team of policy officers across three broad areas of work.

Strengthening Family Ties and Support Structures You will review and develop policies that promote strong family relationships across all life stages, with a particular focus on ensuring that elderly persons are well-supported by their families as they age. This includes identifying gaps in existing frameworks and working with MSF's Family Life Group (FLG) to translate policies into effective programmes and services on the ground.

Strengthening Safeguards for Vulnerable Persons You will lead the review of the Mental Capacity Act and related policies, including those governing professional donees and deputyship, to ensure the legislative framework keeps pace with evolving needs and adequately protects persons who lack mental capacity. You will also drive efforts to encourage Singaporeans, especially the elderly, to plan ahead through instruments such as the Lasting Power of Attorney (LPA), reviewing policies and strategies to improve awareness and uptake.

Funding and Legislative Review You will review MSF's funding approach for family services to ensure support is well-directed and fiscally sustainable, and lead reviews of key legislation including the Women's Charter, Mental Capacity Act, and Child Development Co-Savings Act to keep them aligned with policy objectives.
Throughout all of this, you will work closely with FLG, NPTD and other stakeholders to implement, monitor, and continuously refine your policies based on evidence and ground feedback.
jobRequirements:

•	Ability to propose and build support for evidence-based policies and solutions to address multi-faceted issues and perspectives
•	Good interpersonal and stakeholder management skills 
•	Proactive in working with stakeholders to translate policies and solutions into implementation and monitor results for improvement

jobResponsibilities:
The Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Group (CIG) ensures the security and resiliency of critical ICT infrastructure while monitoring, detecting, and responding to cybersecurity threats to CPFB around the clock. The Data Protection Department, a department within CIG, is responsible for driving infrastructure and data management operations to support our future-ready systems.
In this role, you will:
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify and define internal use cases for optimising products and automating IT operations.
• Partner with technical and business stakeholders to develop comprehensive documentation, standard operating procedures, and knowledge resources that bridge technical complexity with operational clarity.
• Provide operational support for mission-critical cloud infrastructure and security platforms, gaining hands-on experience in troubleshooting, performance optimisation, and platform maintenance within a fast-paced environment.
• Design and implement monitoring solutions and security controls for cloud environments, with opportunities to present findings to senior leadership.

• Currently pursuing a Degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
• Familiar with scripting, automation, infrastructure-as-code, and query languages such as Python, PowerShell, Ansible, Terraform, Elastic Query, Kusto, or SQL.
• Has exposure to cloud platforms, cloud operations, and automation tools such as Azure, AWS, monitoring, automation, or infrastructure support.
• Communicates clearly, both in speaking and writing, and is able to explain technical ideas in a simple way.

jobTitle: Assistant Director / Senior Manager / Manager (Digital Society)
agency: Ministry of Digital Development and Information
agencyDescription: The Ministry of Digital Development and Information (MDDI) drives Singapore’s digital development in four key domains — the economy, government, security, and society. MDDI oversees the development of the infocomm technology, cybersecurity, and media sectors; the Government’s digitalisation initiatives; and the national library, national archives, and public libraries. The Ministry is also responsible for effective public communications, and the Government’s information and public communication policies.
jobDescription: You will formulate, assess and review strategies, policies and programmes to achieve MDDI’s vision of a safe and inclusive Digital Society, where Singaporeans are empowered to harness opportunities afforded by digital technologies, and able to thrive in a digital future. Key policy domains include digital access; inclusive digital design; digital skills, literacy and future readiness; digital well-being, citizenry, and safety.
jobResponsibilities:
As Assistant Director, you will be expected to lead a small team to deliver on projects / a workstream.

•   Contribute to the division’s efforts to develop, drive, coordinate and review digital readiness policies, strategies and programmes for individuals and micro-enterprises across MDDI, its agencies (i.e. the Infocomm Media Development Authority (IMDA), the National Library Board (NLB), the Cyber Security Agency (CSA), the Government Technology Agency (GovTech)) and across the Whole of Government (WOG), working closely with relevant ministries and agencies.

•  Contribute to the coordination and driving a whole-of-MDDI approach and strategy for public education efforts and ensure that approach is relevant, cohesive and effective in addressing emerging issues. This includes planning, formulating and coordinating public communications approaches to engage Singaporeans.

•  Develop and maintain an extensive network of relationships across public, private and people sectors, and ensure an effective and meaningful way to engage, galvanise and bring onboard partners and volunteers to contribute to enhancing the quality, reach and impact of policies and programmes.

• Commission research studies, conduct environment scans and collaborate with local and overseas academia and think tanks to enhance understanding of international and local developments to ensure currency of our efforts and ensure desired outcomes are achieved. This includes working with MDDI divisions to coordinate research agenda and to propagate research outcomes across Whole of Government (WOG) where relevant.

•  Contribute to the development and implementation of tools and approaches for the measurement and assessment of Digital Society outcomes in Singapore

•  Contribute to WOG agenda for lifelong learning through the review and formulation of policies, strategies and programmes related to libraries, archives and learning.

•  Provide secretariat work for committees and structures that will drive the above.
jobRequirements:
• Excellent writing and communication skills

• Strong ability to analyse and think critically about complex issues

• Background in any relevant discipline (e.g. social sciences, communications)

• Passionate about the promotion of digital inclusion, digital literacy, digital well-being and lifelong learning

• Team player with excellent interpersonal skills and good stakeholder management skills

• Work experience in public sector or social services agencies would be advantageous


We regret to inform that only shortlisted candidates would be notified.

For more information on careers in MDDI, please access the link (https://www.mddi.gov.sg/join-us/careers/life-at-mddi/). For more information on our job vacancies, please access Careers@Gov (https://www.careers.gov.sg/) and search for “MDDI” in the Search bar.

jobTitle: Lead Engineer/ Engineer, Corrections Ops (Security Systems), Ops Systems
agency: Home Team Science and Technology Agency (HTX)
agencyDescription: HTX is the world’s first Science and Technology agency that integrates a diverse range of scientific and engineering capabilities to innovate and deliver transformative and operationally-ready solutions for homeland security. As a statutory board of the Ministry of Home Affairs and integral to the Home Team, HTX works at the forefront of science and technology to empower Singapore’s frontline of security. Our shared mission is to amplify, augment and accelerate the Home Team’s advantage and secure Singapore as the safest place on planet earth.
jobDescription: The Engineer/Lead Engineer (Corrections Ops, Security Systems) will assist the Head (Corrections Ops, Security Systems) to ensure the continual operations of effective and sustainable security control systems and other operations and technology (Ops-Tech) solutions for Singapore Prison Service (SPS). This role involves project management, technology refresh and implementation of physical security control systems, such as physical access control, monitoring and communication systems, vehicle scanners and radio communications in the detention and custodial space. The Engineer/Lead Engineer (Corrections Op Systems) will also contribute to the strategic and long-term technology plans to ensure these systems are well-maintained and aligned with the HTD’s transformation and sustainability directions.
jobResponsibilities:
The jobholder is responsible for the following: 
•	Scope the operations requirements to be developed into business case and specifications, evaluate and recommend Ops-Tech solutions that best address the business needs. 
•	Perform procurement of services, conduct evaluation, either independently or with his supervisor, on system proposals submitted by vendors participating in the Tender/Quotation processes called through the government tendering or quotation procedures.
•	Oversee the operations of security control systems and other Ops-Tech systems including ICT systems and services that support these security control systems to ensure that the service-level are maintained.
•	Work with developers to understand and troubleshoot technical problems, and conduct investigation/ analysis of system behaviours, degradations, faults and mishaps in order to identify, evaluate and resolve the system issues.
•	Work closely with other team members in working out detailed technological solutions to meet the operations requirements, taking into account the security and integration features of the proposed enhancements or project proposals.
•	Project manage and ensure the successful implementation of projects and/or enhancements and achieving a high standard of quality control of systems.
jobRequirements:
The jobholder should have: 
•	Tertiary qualification in Computer Science, Information Systems, Information/Infocomm Technology, Computer or Electronics Engineering or related discipline.
•	Minimum 3 years of relevant software development, business analysis or project management working experience. 
•	Proven experience in project management and implementation of physical security systems (physical access control, monitoring and communication systems), ICT systems or other Ops-Tech systems. 
•	Strong analytical, conceptualisation and problem-solving skills.
•	Good communication skills, both oral and written, with the ability to present ideas and influence stakeholders.

The position is based in Changi. 

All new hires are appointed on a two-year contract in the first instance and will be assessed and considered for permanent tenure over time, based on performance.

As part of the shortlisting process for this role, you may be required to complete a medical declaration and/or undergo further assessment.

All applicants will be updated on the status of their applications within 4 weeks upon closing of the advertisement. #L1-FL1

Learner. Creator. Leader

jobDescription: Senior Instructor (Pastry)
jobResponsibilities:
We are seeking an experienced and passionate Senior Pastry Instructor to join our teaching team at Bistro Lab, a unique Learning Enterprise where students receive hands-on training in hot kitchen production, baking and pastry, customer service, and food innovation. The ideal candidate will have a strong background working in hotel pastry kitchens, catering companies, or large-scale F&B production environments, coupled with a genuine passion for teaching and mentoring young talent.


This role involves classroom teaching, practical kitchen instruction, and supporting the daily operations of Bistro Lab in a real-world production setting. The instructor will also contribute to R&D initiatives, including recipe development using novel or alternative ingredients, and is encouraged to bring creativity and innovation into the learning environment. Candidates with experience in Culinary R&D, Culinary technology and exposure to digital and smart kitchen systems will be highly regarded.


The responsibilities are as follows:


• Conduct hands-on demonstrations in baking and pastry techniques to students, with emphasis on latest technology, ingredient functionality, baking science, product formulation, and recipe development.
• Support Bistro Lab’s daily production and operational requirements in a teaching environment, ensuring kitchen safety and food hygiene.
• Develop innovative products for the Bistro Lab and integrate them into the teaching curriculum.
• Contribute to R&D projects, including recipe development using novel or alternative ingredients.
• Where applicable, coach or prepare students for pastry competitions.
jobRequirements:
• Relevant qualification/certification in Baking & Pastry, Culinary Arts, or in a related discipline.
• Minimum 5 to 8 years of relevant industry experience working in hotel kitchens, catering companies, or large-scale F&B production environments.
• Proficiency in classical and modern pastry and baking techniques, with both theoretical knowledge and hands-on application.
• Experience in Pastry R&D, recipe development, or product formulation including use of novel and alternative ingredients.
• Knowledge of food science, with experience participating in or coaching students for pastry competitions considered an added advantage.

jobTitle: Manager/Senior Manager, Youth Engagement and Research (ICPD)
agencyDescription:
The Skills and Workforce Development Agency (SWDA), a statutory board under the Ministry of Manpower (MOM), drives lifelong learning and workforce development to enable Singaporeans to take charge of their careers, learn for life, access good jobs, and grow in fulfilling careers. We enable employers to build a skilled, future-ready workforce, design quality jobs, and adopt skills recognition practices. Together with our partners, we build a trusted, high-quality, industry-relevant, and innovative ecosystem that meets the evolving workforce needs of both businesses and workers.   

Guided by our vision of a Singapore where everyone can grow in fulfilling careers, we live our promise of Building Skills, Growing Careers by nurturing lifelong learning, strengthening employability and enabling career growth for all, including our own officers, through a continuous learning culture and a supportive, flexible, inclusive working environment that fosters innovation, collaboration, and well-being.

So, join us to be part of a dynamic team driving the national SkillsFuture movement and building a strong Singaporean core. Together, we create opportunities, transform lives, and shape the future of work.
jobDescription:
You will be supporting SWDA's efforts to deepen our understanding of youths’ career aspirations and behaviours, and shape initiatives that strengthen youths’ engagement with career development and planning. You will lead research efforts, pilot programmes and associated funding and grants management processes that inform policy and engagement strategies to support youths’ school-to-work transitions and their early careers.

As a Senior Manager/ Manager in Youth Engagement and Research, you will:
jobResponsibilities:
• Conduct qualitative and quantitative research to understand perceptions, motivations, challenges, and behaviours of youths pertaining to work and career planning
  • Identify and explore emerging youths-related trends in education, employment, values and identity, and how these impact school-to-work transitions and early career decisions and pathways
  • Synthesize research insights into actionable recommendations to inform programmes, partnerships, and outreach strategies
  • Support internal teams with youth-related insights and frameworks to ensure initiatives are designed with empathy and relevance
  • Engage with youth-focused organisations, educators, community groups, and ecosystem partners to develop collaborative initiatives and expand outreach
  • Cultivate and maintain strong partnerships with youth organisations, education institutions and community stakeholders to co-develop impactful initiatives
  • Design and lead youth-centric pilot initiatives and engagements to test new approaches to career development and planning, including both digital and in-person formats
  • Develop funding proposals, grant applications and programme budgets for youth-related initiatives and pilots
  • Manage and monitor grants and programme funding for assigned initiatives, ensuring compliance with funding requirements, proper governance, and effective utilisation of resources
  • Work closely with internal stakeholders to ensure timely funding disbursement, tracking and reporting of programme outcomes
  • Track and evaluate the outcomes and effectiveness of youth-related initiatives and surface insights for broader implementation
  • Present insights and recommendations clearly and persuasively to internal and external stakeholders, including senior management and external partners
jobRequirements:
You should have the following work experience and knowledge:

  • Relevant experience in youth engagement, market and consumer/user research, programme development, community development and/or grants/funding management
  • Strong grasp of qualitative and/or quantitative research methods, including survey design, interviews, focus groups, or user testing
  • Familiarity with trends in youth development, education-to-work transitions, and socio-economic issues affecting young people
  • Experience working with or designing initiatives for diverse youth profiles, including students, graduates, and early-career workers
  • Proficient in MS Office, especially PowerPoint and Excel; familiarity with data visualisation or research tools is a plus

You should possess the following skill sets:

  • Youth Empathy and Engagement: Able to relate to and connect with diverse youth mindsets; comfortable designing programmes or touchpoints that resonate with their needs and realities
  • Research and Insight Development: Skilled in gathering, analysing and interpreting data to surface insights that shape programmes and strategies
  • Stakeholder Engagement: Confident in engaging partners across public, private, and people sectors to co-create initiatives or amplify outreach
  • Partnership Development: Capable of identifying, cultivating and sustaining strategic partnerships with youth-focused organisations, education institutions and community groups to co-develop initiatives that better support youths in their career exploration and transitions
  • Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills to convey research findings and initiative proposals with clarity and influence
  • Initiative and Adaptability: Self-motivated, adaptable and resourceful; able to navigate ambiguity and move ideas forward from concept to execution
  • Project Management: Strong planning and coordination skills to manage pilots, studies, or outreach initiatives from start to finish
  • Finance and Grants Management: Ability to manage programme budgets, oversee grant administration, and ensure compliance with funding and reporting requirements

Successful candidates will be offered a contract in the first instance and may be considered for an extension or be placed on a permanent tenure.

Candidates are encouraged to sign up for a Careers & Skills Passport (CSP) account and include your CSP public profile in your resume. Please check out www.myskillsfuture.gov.sg for details on the CSP.

agencyDescription:
The National Environment Agency (NEA) is the leading public organisation responsible for ensuring a clean and sustainable environment for Singapore. Its key roles are to improve and sustain a clean environment, promote sustainability and resource efficiency, maintain high public health standards, provide timely and reliable meteorological information, and encourage a vibrant hawker culture. NEA works closely with its partners and the community to develop and spearhead environmental and public health initiatives and programmes. It is committed to motivating every individual to care for the environment as a way of life, in order to build a liveable and sustainable Singapore for present and future generations.

For more information, visit www.nea.gov.sg
jobDescription: You will be part of a project team working closely with the appointed consultant and stakeholders on the development of the Integrated Waste Management Facility Phase 2 (IP2) – a large-scale waste management infrastructural project.
jobResponsibilities:
Your main responsibilities are as follows:

  • Review and evaluate technical design submissions for electrical equipment, process, instrument, control and automation systems such as electrical switchgears, transformers, generators, protection relay systems, Distributed Control System (DCS), instruments and control equipment, waste handling cranes, steam turbine-generators, flue gas treatments, etc.

  • Work closely with the consultant, relevant agencies and authorities to oversee the construction and commissioning of IWMF Phase 2 project

  • Prepare tender documents, evaluate tender bid proposals

  • Verify progress payments

  • Lead a technical team to ensure safe and efficient operation of facilities when IWMF Phase 2 is in operational stage
jobRequirements:
• Degree in Electrical or Electronic Engineering

  • At least of 3 years of relevant experience in waste-to-energy facilities preferred, though candidates with other relevant experience will also be considered.

  • Professional certification (e.g. Professional Engineer, Licenced Electrical Worker) will be advantageous.

  • Responsible, committed, resourceful, and a good team player

  • Good interpersonal communication, presentation and writing skills

  • Able to perform shift work, including weekends and public holidays, if required, when IWMF Phase 2 is in the commissioning and operational stage

As part of the shortlisting process for this role, you may be required to complete a medical declaration and/or undergo further assessment.

agencyDescription:
Master planner. Developer. Since its inception in 1968, JTC has played a strategic role in ensuring Singapore stays innovative, dynamic, and sensitive to global manufacturing trends.

A government agency under Singapore’s Ministry of Trade and Industry, JTC is paving the way forward for Singapore’s industrial landscape by championing clean, green and smart estates such as one-north, Seletar Aerospace Park, Jurong Innovation District, and Punggol Digital District. It is developing infrastructure, systems and initiatives that bridge cutting-edge technology and human skill to fuel growth.  

JTC is also bringing businesses and communities together through green spaces, cultivating an environment that is not only sustainable but nurtures ideas shaping the future.
jobDescription: You will act as a client representative electrical design engineer for JTC and various public sector agencies for building and infrastructure projects as well as industrial estates. You will coordinate with the Energy Market Authority (EMA) and Singapore Power (SP) PowerGrid to plan transmission (66kV and above) and distribution (22kV) electrical infrastructure supporting JTC industrial estates.
jobResponsibilities:
You will formulate project briefs for consultancy tenders, manage consultants and review their electrical designs for various subsystems, technical calculations, specifications, drawings, material submissions, and M&E cost estimates from design through project completion.

Using engineering calculation software, you will conduct value engineering and cost-benefit analyses whilst ensuring compliance with local construction industry regulations and codes.


Working with multiple public sector agencies and technical professionals, you will manage broad project work scopes, resources and timelines. You will collaborate with JTC colleagues to forecast future industrial power demand and work with government agencies, EMA and SP Group to plan network upgrades and new substation construction.

You will represent JTC in various agency committees, effectively communicating engineering concepts and driving innovative solutions across stakeholder groups.
jobRequirements:
• Background in Electrical or Power Engineering with at least 2-3 years of relevant experience in consultancy, design and/or electrical network planning

  • Registration with the Professional Engineer's Board (PEB) would be an advantage

  • Certifications such as Design for Safety Professional, Green Mark, and Building Construction certifications advantageous

  • Strong grasp of engineering concepts with ability to work independently and collaboratively

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills for stakeholder coordination

  • Self-driven and dynamic approach to project management

agencyDescription: Sentosa Development Corporation (SDC) was established on 1 September 1972 as a Statutory Board under the Ministry of Trade and Industry. Its charter since inception has been to oversee the development, management and promotion of the Sentosa Island as a resort destination for locals and tourists. Under the care of SDC, the island went through a makeover to become a premier getaway with multi-faceted appeal. From business conventions to beach parties, Sentosa caters to an extensive range of needs and interests. SDC has evolved and grown over the years. As Senior Manager, Brand, you lead how Sentosa shows up in the world and turn brand strategy into experiences guests can feel. You hold the brand standard across everything the team creates, you bring marquee partners into the Sentosa world in ways that raise the island's appeal, and you help transform on-island spaces into experiences worth returning for.

You lead a small, high-craft brand team and develop a Deputy Manager alongside you. The role asks for someone equally comfortable holding a room of senior partners and holding the line on a brand principle. You are a brand builder who works in the details and stands behind the decisions.
jobResponsibilities:
The Senior Manager, Brand, leads the stewardship and elevation of the Sentosa brand across the island experience. Together with a Deputy Manager, this role forms the brand team that acts as guardian of the brand – holding a consistent, best-in-class brand standard across everything the Marketing & Guest Experience (MGX) division creates, on and off the island.

The role carries three connected mandates: overall brand governance, brand partnerships that build brand visibility and desirability, and the transformation of on-island spaces into distinctive, return-worthy experiences. As Sentosa progresses the Greater Sentosa Master Plan, the brand must stay true to the soul and identity of the island while shaping the next generation of world-class experiences, deepening its appeal to Singaporeans and visitors alike. Reporting to the Head of Brand & Product Marketing, the role operates within a shared brand-governance framework alongside the international and commercial partnerships lead, ensuring one coherent brand across the full portfolio. The measure of success is a Sentosa brand that locals feel ownership of, and partners want to be part of.

Brand Governance & Stewardship

  • Act as guardian of the Sentosa brand, upholding a consistent and best-in-class brand standard across all on- and off-island marketing, partnerships, and guest touchpoints.

  • Own the brand framework – positioning, promise, voice, and visual identity, translating it into clear, usable guidance that raises the quality of work across the division.

  • Operate within a shared brand-governance framework with the international and commercial partnerships lead, maintaining one coherent brand across the full partnership portfolio.

  • Bring brand judgement to strategic decisions, holding the line on brand principles even under commercial or operational pressure.

Brand Partnerships for Brand Visibility

  • Originate and lead the on-island and experiential brand partnership portfolio, namely marquee, consumer-facing partners that elevate the brand and drive desirability, footfall, and cultural relevance.

  • Assess and shape partnerships against the divisional selection criteria (Reach and Brand Alignment as essentials, plus at least two of Brand Love, Clout, and Legacy), ensuring every partnership is true to the brand and elevates it.

  • Represent Sentosa with marquee partners and senior stakeholders, holding high-value relationships independently and with presence.

  • Turn signature partnerships into repeatable playbooks and case studies that strengthen future partnership pitches.

On-Island Space Transformation

  • Lead the reimagining of on-island spaces into distinctive, brand-led experiences that give Singaporeans and visitors compelling reasons to return, across different times of the day and seasons of life.

  • Partner across divisions to translate brand thinking into physical placemaking, activations, and guest experiences that express the brand promise.

  • Drive the improvement and automation of the on-island review and booking experience, streamlining how guests discover and access island experiences.

Team Leadership & Delivery

  • Lead and develop a Deputy Manager, building brand craft, campaign-planning capability, and delivery discipline within the brand team.

  • Manage brand campaigns end-to-end – from strategic brief through execution to post-campaign evaluation – with clear objectives, KPIs, and timelines.

  • Manage brand and partnership budgets with financial rigour, optimising spend to maximise brand impact and return.
jobRequirements:
